sentences.en: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?
sentences.zh: 作者为什么要向他身后的人抱怨？

sentences.en: Last week I went to the theatre.
sentences.zh: 上周我去了剧院。

sentences.en: I had a very good seat.
sentences.zh: 我有一个很好的座位。

sentences.en: The play was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 戏很有趣。

sentences.en: I did not enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 我却没有享受到乐趣。

sentences.en: A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me.
sentences.zh: 一对年轻的男女坐在我身后。

sentences.en: They were talking loudly.
sentences.zh: 他们大声地说着话。

sentences.en: I got very angry.
sentences.zh: 我非常生气。

sentences.en: I could not hear the actors.
sentences.zh: 我听不见演员的讲话。

sentences.en: I turned round.
sentences.zh: 我转过身。

sentences.en: I looked at the man and the woman angrily.
sentences.zh: 我怒气冲冲地看着那一男一女。

sentences.en: They did not pay any attention.
sentences.zh: 他们却不理不睬。

sentences.en: In the end, I could not bear it.
sentences.zh: 最后，我忍不住了。

sentences.en: I turned round again.
sentences.zh: 我又转过身去。

sentences.en: 'I can't hear a word!' I said angrily.
sentences.zh: “我一个字也听不见了！”我生气地说。

sentences.en: 'It's none of your business,'
sentences.zh: “不关你的事，”

sentences.en: the young man said rudely.
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人粗鲁地说。

sentences.en: 'This is a private conversation!'
sentences.zh: “这是私人谈话！”

sentences.en: Why was the writer's aunt surprised?
sentences.zh: 作家的阿姨为什么感到惊讶？

sentences.en: It was Sunday.
sentences.zh: 那是星期天。

sentences.en: I never get up early on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我星期天从不起早。

sentences.en: I sometimes stay in bed until lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 我有时会一直睡到午饭时间。

sentences.en: Last Sunday I got up very late.
sentences.zh: 上个星期天我起得很晚。

sentences.en: I looked out of the window.
sentences.zh: 我向窗外望去。

sentences.en: It was dark outside.
sentences.zh: 外面天很黑。

sentences.en: 'What a day!' I thought.
sentences.zh: “这是什么天气啊！”我想。

sentences.en: 'It's raining again.'
sentences.zh: “又下雨了。”

sentences.en: Just then, the telephone rang.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，电话响了。

sentences.en: It was my aunt Lucy.
sentences.zh: 是我的露西姨妈。

sentences.en: 'I've just arrived by train,' she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我刚乘火车到了。”

sentences.en: 'I'm coming to see you.'
sentences.zh: “我要来看你。”

sentences.en: 'But I'm still having breakfast,' I said.
sentences.zh: “可是我还在吃早饭呢。”我说。

sentences.en: 'What are you doing?' she asked.
sentences.zh: 她问：“你在做什么？”

sentences.en: 'I'm having breakfast,' I repeated.
sentences.zh: “我在吃早饭。”我重复道。

sentences.en: 'Dear me,' she said.
sentences.zh: “哎呀！”她说。

sentences.en: 'Do you always get up so late?
sentences.zh: “你总是起这么晚吗？

sentences.en: It's one o'clock!'
sentences.zh: 已经一点钟了！”

sentences.en: How many cards did the writer send?
sentences.zh: 作者寄了多少张明信片？

sentences.en: Postcards always spoil my holidays.
sentences.zh: 明信片总是破坏我的假期。

sentences.en: Last summer, I went to Italy.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我去了意大利。

sentences.en: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.
sentences.zh: 我参观了博物馆，并坐在公共花园里。

sentences.en: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的服务员教了我几句意大利语。

sentences.en: Then he lent me a book.
sentences.zh: 然后他借给我一本书。

sentences.en: I read a few lines, but I did not understand a word.
sentences.zh: 我读了几行，但一个字也看不懂。

sentences.en: Every day I thought about postcards.
sentences.zh: 每天我都想着明信片。

sentences.en: My holidays passed quickly,
sentences.zh: 我的假期过得很快，

sentences.en: but I did not send cards to my friends.
sentences.zh: 但我没有给朋友们寄明信片。

sentences.en: On the last day I made a big decision.
sentences.zh: 在最后一天，我做了一个重大决定。

sentences.en: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
sentences.zh: 我起得很早，买了三十七张明信片。

sentences.en: I spent the whole day in my room,
sentences.zh: 我在房间里待了一整天，

sentences.en: but I did not write a single card!
sentences.zh: 但我一张明信片也没写！

sentences.en: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?
sentences.zh: 蒂姆为什么觉得这次旅行令人兴奋？

sentences.en: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到我哥哥蒂姆的一封信。

sentences.en: He is in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他在澳大利亚。

sentences.en: He has been there for six months.
sentences.zh: 他在那里已经六个月了。

sentences.en: Tim is an engineer.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆是一名工程师。

sentences.en: He is working for a big firm and he has already visited
sentences.zh: 他在一家大公司工作，并且他已经参观了

sentences.en: a great number of different places in Australia.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的许多不同地方。

sentences.en: He has just bought an Australian car and has gone to Alice Springs,
sentences.zh: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚汽车，然后去了爱丽丝泉，

sentences.en: a small town in the centre of Australia.
sentences.zh: 一个位于澳大利亚中部的小镇。

sentences.en: He will soon visit Darwin.
sentences.zh: 他很快将参观达尔文。

sentences.en: From there, he will fly to Perth.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他将飞往珀斯。

sentences.en: My brother has never been abroad before,
sentences.zh: 我哥哥以前从未出过国，

sentences.en: so he is finding this trip very exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以他觉得这次旅行非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: What does 'No wrong numbers' mean?
sentences.zh: “没有打错的电话”是什么意思？

sentences.en: Mr.James Scott has a garage in Silbury
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在西尔伯里有一家汽车修理厂

sentences.en: and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
sentences.zh: 现在他刚刚在平赫斯特又买了一家。

sentences.en: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury,
sentences.zh: 平赫斯特离西尔伯里只有五英里，

sentences.en: but Mr. Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage,
sentences.zh: 但斯科特先生无法为他的新修理厂安装电话，

sentences.en: so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
sentences.zh: 所以他刚买了十二只鸽子。

sentences.en: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
sentences.zh: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特带到了西尔伯里。

sentences.en: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
sentences.zh: 这只鸟在三分钟内飞完了这段距离。

sentences.en: Up to now,
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，

sentences.en: Mr.Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts
sentences.zh: 斯科特先生已经送出了大量的备件请求

sentences.en: and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
sentences.zh: 以及其他紧急信息，从一家修理厂到另一家。

sentences.en: In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，他开创了自己私人的“电话”服务。

sentences.en: Who is Percy Buttons?
sentences.zh: 谁是珀西·巴顿斯？

sentences.en: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到桥街的一所房子里。

sentences.en: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
sentences.zh: 昨天一个乞丐敲我的门。

sentences.en: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
sentences.zh: 他向我要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

sentences.en: In return for this,
sentences.zh: 作为回报，

sentences.en: the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
sentences.zh: 乞丐倒立着唱歌。

sentences.en: I gave him a meal.
sentences.zh: 我给了他一顿饭。

sentences.en: He ate the food and drank the beer.
sentences.zh: 他吃了食物，喝了啤酒。

sentences.en: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
sentences.zh: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋里，走了。

sentences.en: Later a neighbour told me about him.
sentences.zh: 后来一位邻居告诉我关于他的事。

sentences.en: Everybody knows him.
sentences.zh: 每个人都认识他。

sentences.en: His name is Percy Buttons.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯。

sentences.en: He calls at every house in the street once a month
sentences.zh: 他每个月到街上的每家每户拜访一次

sentences.en: and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
sentences.zh: 并且总是要求一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

sentences.en: Did the detectives save the diamonds?
sentences.zh: 侦探们保住钻石了吗？

sentences.en: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
sentences.zh: 飞机晚点了，侦探们在机场等了一上午。

sentences.en: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
sentences.zh: 他们正在等一个从南非寄来的贵重钻石包裹。

sentences.en: A few hours earlier,
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，

sentences.en: someone had told the police that
sentences.zh: 有人告诉警方，

sentences.en: thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
sentences.zh: 小偷会设法偷走这些钻石。

sentences.en: When the plane arrived,
sentences.zh: 飞机抵达时，

sentences.en: some of the detectives were waiting
sentences.zh: 一些侦探在

sentences.en: inside the main building
sentences.zh: 主楼里等候，

sentences.en: while others were waiting on the airfield.
sentences.zh: 另一些则在机场跑道上等候。

sentences.en: Two men took the parcel off the plane
sentences.zh: 两名男子把包裹从飞机上卸下来，

sentences.en: and carried it into the Customs House.
sentences.zh: 并把它搬进了海关。

sentences.en: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door,
sentences.zh: 两名侦探在门口守卫，

sentences.en: two others opened the parcel.
sentences.zh: 另外两名打开了包裹。

sentences.en: To their surprise,
sentences.zh: 令他们吃惊的是，

sentences.en: the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
sentences.zh: 这个贵重包裹里装满了石头和沙子！

sentences.en: Why is Joe's garden
sentences.zh: 为什么乔的花园

sentences.en: the most beautiful one in the town?
sentences.zh: 是镇上最漂亮的一个？

sentences.en: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden
sentences.zh: 乔·桑德斯拥有最美丽的花园

sentences.en: in our town.
sentences.zh: 在我们镇上。

sentences.en: Nearly everybody enters for
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人都报名参加

sentences.en: 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year,
sentences.zh: 每年的“最美花园竞赛”，

sentences.en: but Joe wins every time.
sentences.zh: 但乔每次都赢。

sentences.en: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
sentences.zh: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的花园大。

sentences.en: Bill works harder than Joe
sentences.zh: 比尔比乔更努力工作

sentences.en: and grows more flowers and vegetables,
sentences.zh: 并且种植更多的花卉和蔬菜，

sentences.en: but Joe's garden is more interesting.
sentences.zh: 但乔的花园更有趣。

sentences.en: He has made neat paths
sentences.zh: 他修建了整齐的小径

sentences.en: and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
sentences.zh: 并在池塘上架起了一座木桥。

sentences.en: I like gardens too,
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢花园，

sentences.en: but I do not like hard work.
sentences.zh: 但我不喜欢辛苦劳作。

sentences.en: Every year
sentences.zh: 每年

sentences.en: I enter for the garden competition too,
sentences.zh: 我也参加花园竞赛，

sentences.en: and I always win a little prize
sentences.zh: 我总是赢得一个小奖

sentences.en: for the worst garden in the town!
sentences.zh: 因为我是镇上最差的花园！

sentences.en: What does 'a cold welcome' refer to?
sentences.zh: “冷淡的欢迎”指的是什么？

sentences.en: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
sentences.zh: 星期三晚上，我们去了市政厅。

sentences.en: It was the last day of the year
sentences.zh: 那是今年的最后一天，

sentences.en: and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
sentences.zh: 一大群人聚集在市政厅大钟下面。

sentences.en: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
sentences.zh: 再过二十分钟，大钟就要敲响十二点了。

sentences.en: Fifteen minutes passed and then,
sentences.zh: 十五分钟过去了，接着，

sentences.en: at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
sentences.zh: 在十二点差五分的时候，大钟停了。

sentences.en: The big minute hand did not move.
sentences.zh: 巨大的分针一动不动。

sentences.en: We waited and waited,
sentences.zh: 我们等啊等，

sentences.en: but nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 但什么也没有发生。

sentences.en: Suddenly someone shouted.
sentences.zh: 突然有人喊道：

sentences.en: 'It's two minutes past twelve!
sentences.zh: “已经十二点过两分了！

sentences.en: The clock has stopped!'
sentences.zh: 大钟停了！”

sentences.en: I looked at my watch.
sentences.zh: 我看了看我的表。

sentences.en: It was true.
sentences.zh: 果然如此。

sentences.en: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
sentences.zh: 那座大钟拒不迎接新年。

sentences.en: At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，所有人都开始笑啊唱啊。

sentences.en: What happened to the clavichord?
sentences.zh: 古钢琴怎么了？

sentences.en: We have an old musical instrument.
sentences.zh: 我们有一件古老的乐器。

sentences.en: It is called a clavichord.
sentences.zh: 它被称为古钢琴。

sentences.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
sentences.zh: 它于1681年在德国制造。

sentences.en: Our clavichord is kept in the living room.
sentences.zh: 我们的古钢琴被放在客厅里。

sentences.en: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
sentences.zh: 它属于我们家已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
sentences.zh: 这件乐器是我祖父多年前买的。

sentences.en: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
sentences.zh: 最近它被一位访客损坏了。

sentences.en: She tried to play jazz on it!
sentences.zh: 她试图用它演奏爵士乐！

sentences.en: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
sentences.zh: 她敲击琴键太用力，结果两根琴弦断了。

sentences.en: My father was shocked.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲感到震惊。

sentences.en: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们不被允许碰它。

sentences.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
sentences.zh: 它正在由我父亲的一位朋友修理。

sentences.en: Who paid for Tony's dinner?
sentences.zh: 谁付了托尼的晚餐钱？

sentences.en: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
sentences.zh: 我正在一家餐馆吃饭，这时托尼·斯蒂尔走了进来。

sentences.en: Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago,
sentences.zh: 托尼多年前在一家律师事务所工作，

sentences.en: but he is now working at a bank.
sentences.zh: 但他现在在一家银行工作。

sentences.en: He gets a good salary,
sentences.zh: 他薪水很高，

sentences.en: but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
sentences.zh: 但他总是向朋友借钱，从不还。

sentences.en: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
sentences.zh: 托尼看到了我，走过来坐在同一张桌子旁。

sentences.en: He has never borrowed money from me.
sentences.zh: 他从没向我借过钱。

sentences.en: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
sentences.zh: 他吃饭的时候，我请他借给我二十英镑。

sentences.en: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻把钱给了我。

sentences.en: 'I have never borrowed any money from you,'
sentences.zh: “我从没向你借过钱，”

sentences.en: Tony said, 'so now you can pay for my dinner!'
sentences.zh: 托尼说，“所以现在你可以为我的晚餐付钱了！”

sentences.en: Where is Captain Alison going and how?
sentences.zh: 艾莉森船长要去哪里，怎么去？

sentences.en: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们的邻居，查尔斯·艾莉森船长，明天将从朴茨茅斯启航。

sentences.en: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我们明天一早将在港口与他会合。

sentences.en: He will be in his small boat, Topsail.
sentences.zh: 他将乘坐他的小船“上帆号”。

sentences.en: Topsail is a famous little boat.
sentences.zh: “上帆号”是一艘著名的小船。

sentences.en: It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
sentences.zh: 它已经多次横渡大西洋。

sentences.en: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock,
sentences.zh: 艾莉森船长将在八点钟出发，

sentences.en: so we'll have plenty of time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有充足的时间。

sentences.en: We'll see his boat and then we'll say goodbye to him.
sentences.zh: 我们将去看他的船，然后向他告别。

sentences.en: He will be away for two months.
sentences.zh: 他将离开两个月。

sentences.en: We are very proud of him.
sentences.zh: 我们为他感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 他将参加一场重要的横渡大西洋的比赛。

sentences.en: Why will the police have a difficult time?
sentences.zh: 警察为什么会遇到困难？

sentences.en: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
sentences.zh: “格林伍德少年”是一个流行歌手组合。

sentences.en: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们正在全国各地巡回演出。

sentences.en: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他们明天将抵达这里。

sentences.en: They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
sentences.zh: 他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分年轻人会去车站迎接他们。

sentences.en: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
sentences.zh: 明天晚上，他们将在工人俱乐部演唱。

sentences.en: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
sentences.zh: “格林伍德少年”将停留5天。

sentences.en: During this time, they will give five performances.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他们将演出5场。

sentences.en: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，警察将遇到很多麻烦。

sentences.en: They will be trying to keep order.
sentences.zh: 他们将尽力维持秩序。

sentences.en: It is always the same on these occasions.
sentences.zh: 每逢这种场合，情况总是如此。

sentences.en: Did the young man speak English?
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人会说英语吗？

sentences.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我有一个有趣的经历。

sentences.en: After I had left a small village in the south of France,
sentences.zh: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄后，

sentences.en: I drove on to the next town.
sentences.zh: 我驱车前往下一个城镇。

sentences.en: On the way, a young man waved to me.
sentences.zh: 在路上，一个年轻人向我招手。

sentences.en: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
sentences.zh: 我停了下来，他请求我搭他一程。

sentences.en: As soon as he had got into the car,
sentences.zh: 他一上车，

sentences.en: I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
sentences.zh: 我就用法语向他问好，他也用同样的语言回答我。

sentences.en: Apart from a few words,
sentences.zh: 除了一些词语，

sentences.en: I do not know any French at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点法语也不会。

sentences.en: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
sentences.zh: 在旅途中，我们两人都没有说话。

sentences.en: I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly,
sentences.zh: 我快到城镇时，那个年轻人突然非常缓慢地说，

sentences.en: 'Do you speak English?'
sentences.zh: “你会说英语吗？”

sentences.en: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
sentences.zh: 我很快了解到，他自己就是英国人！

sentences.en: What was the good news?
sentences.zh: 好消息是什么？

sentences.en: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
sentences.zh: 秘书告诉我哈姆斯沃思先生会见我。

sentences.en: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
sentences.zh: 当我走进他的办公室时，我感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
sentences.zh: 我进去时，他没有从办公桌上抬起头。

sentences.en: After I had sat down,
sentences.zh: 我坐下后，

sentences.en: he said that business was very bad.
sentences.zh: 他说生意很糟。

sentences.en: He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我公司负担不起支付如此高的薪水。

sentences.en: Twenty people had already left.
sentences.zh: 已经有二十人离开了。

sentences.en: I knew that my turn had come.
sentences.zh: 我知道轮到我了。

sentences.en: 'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice.
sentences.zh: “哈姆斯沃思先生，”我用微弱的声音说。

sentences.en: 'Don't interrupt,' he said.
sentences.zh: “不要打断，”他说。

sentences.en: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
sentences.zh: 然后他笑了，告诉我每年将额外获得一千英镑！

sentences.en: What was the polite request?
sentences.zh: 有礼貌的请求是什么？

sentences.en: If you park your car in the wrong place,
sentences.zh: 如果你把车停错了地方，

sentences.en: a traffic policeman will soon find it.
sentences.zh: 交通警察很快就会发现它。

sentences.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
sentences.zh: 如果他让你走而不开罚单，你将非常幸运。

sentences.en: However, this does not always happen.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并非总是发生。

sentences.en: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
sentences.zh: 交通警察有时非常有礼貌。

sentences.en: During a holiday in Sweden,
sentences.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，

sentences.en: I found this note on my car:
sentences.zh: 我在车上发现了这张字条：

sentences.en: 'sir, we welcome you to our city. This is a No Parking area.
sentences.zh: “先生，我们欢迎您来到我们的城市。这里是禁停区。

sentences.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs. This note is only a reminder.'
sentences.zh: 如果您注意我们的路标，您会在这里度过愉快的时光。这张字条只是一个提醒。”

sentences.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
sentences.zh: 如果你收到这样的请求，你不能不遵守它！

sentences.en: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗姨妈为什么不告诉任何人她多大了？

sentences.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
sentences.zh: 我的珍妮弗姨妈是个演员。

sentences.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
sentences.zh: 她肯定至少35岁了。

sentences.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是经常在舞台上扮演一个年轻姑娘。

sentences.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗很快就要参加一个新剧的演出了。

sentences.en: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
sentences.zh: 这次，她将扮演一个17岁的姑娘。

sentences.en: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
sentences.zh: 在剧中，她必须穿一件鲜红的连衣裙和一双长长的黑丝袜。

sentences.en: Last year in another play,
sentences.zh: 去年在另一个剧中，

sentences.en: she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
sentences.zh: 她不得不穿短袜和一件鲜艳的橙色连衣裙。

sentences.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is,
sentences.zh: 如果有人问起她多大了，

sentences.en: she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
sentences.zh: 她总是回答说：“亲爱的，长大成人真是太可怕了！”

sentences.en: What had happened to the writer's bag?
sentences.zh: 作家的包怎么了？

sentences.en: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
sentences.zh: 我在一家乡村酒吧吃过午饭后，就去找我的包。

sentences.en: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
sentences.zh: 我把它放在门旁边的一把椅子上，现在它不在那里了！

sentences.en: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
sentences.zh: 当我正在找它的时候，房东进来了。

sentences.en: 'Did you have a good meal?' he asked.
sentences.zh: “你吃得好吗？”他问。

sentences.en: 'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.'
sentences.zh: “是的，谢谢你，”我回答说，“但我付不了账单。我没有我的包。”

sentences.en: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
sentences.zh: 房东笑了，立刻出去了。

sentences.en: In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他带着我的包回来了，并把它还给了我。

sentences.en: 'I'm very sorry,' he said.
sentences.zh: “我非常抱歉，”他说。

sentences.en: 'My dog had taken it into the garden. He often does this!'
sentences.zh: “我的狗把它叼到花园里去了。它经常这样做！”

sentences.en: When will the writer see the play?
sentences.zh: 作者什么时候会看这部戏？

sentences.en: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.
sentences.zh: “这出戏随时都可能开始，”我说。

sentences.en: 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.
sentences.zh: “可能已经开始了，”苏珊回答说。

sentences.en: I hurried to the ticket office.
sentences.zh: 我赶紧跑到售票处。

sentences.en: 'May I have two tickets please?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “请给我两张票好吗？”我问道。

sentences.en: 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.
sentences.zh: “对不起，票已经卖完了，”那个女孩说。

sentences.en: 'What a pity!' Susan exclaimed.
sentences.zh: “真可惜！”苏珊惊呼道。

sentences.en: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一个男人匆匆跑到售票处。

sentences.en: 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked.
sentences.zh: “我能退这两张票吗？”他问道。

sentences.en: 'Certainly,' the girl said.
sentences.zh: “当然可以，”那个女孩说。

sentences.en: I went back to the ticket office at once.
sentences.zh: 我立刻回到了售票处。

sentences.en: 'Could I have those two tickets please?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “我能要那两张票吗？”我问道。

sentences.en: 'Certainly,' the girl said,
sentences.zh: “当然可以，”那个女孩说，

sentences.en: 'but they're for next Wednesday's performance.
sentences.zh: “但那是下周三演出的票。

sentences.en: Do you still want them?'
sentences.zh: 你还要吗？”

sentences.en: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
sentences.zh: “我还是把它们拿走吧，”我伤心地说。

sentences.en: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?
sentences.zh: 为什么钓鱼是作者最喜欢的运动？

sentences.en: Fishing is my favourite sport.
sentences.zh: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。

sentences.en: I often fish for hours without catching anything.
sentences.zh: 我经常钓好几个小时，却什么也钓不到。

sentences.en: But this does not worry me.
sentences.zh: 但这并不困扰我。

sentences.en: Some fishermen are unlucky.
sentences.zh: 有些渔夫运气不好。

sentences.en: Instead of catching fish,
sentences.zh: 他们不是钓到鱼，

sentences.en: they catch old boots and rubbish.
sentences.zh: 而是钓到旧靴子和垃圾。

sentences.en: I am even less lucky.
sentences.zh: 我甚至更不走运。

sentences.en: I never catch anything -- not even old boots.
sentences.zh: 我什么也钓不到——甚至连旧靴子都钓不到。

sentences.en: After having spent whole mornings on the river,
sentences.zh: 在河上度过整个上午之后，

sentences.en: I always go home with an empty bag.
sentences.zh: 我总是空手回家。

sentences.en: 'You must give up fishing!' my friends say. 'It's a waste of time.'
sentences.zh: “你必须放弃钓鱼！”我的朋友们说，“这简直是浪费时间。”

sentences.en: But they don't realize one important thing.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有意识到一件重要的事情。

sentences.en: I'm not really interested in fishing.
sentences.zh: 我对钓鱼并不真正感兴趣。

sentences.en: I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
sentences.zh: 我只对坐在船上什么也不做感兴趣！

sentences.en: Why do people think the writer is mad?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们认为这位作者疯了？

sentences.en: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
sentences.zh: 飞机正慢慢地把我逼疯。

sentences.en: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.
sentences.zh: 我住在一个机场附近，飞机从早到晚轰鸣而过。

sentences.en: The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then.
sentences.zh: 机场是多年前修建的，但由于某种原因，那时无法投入使用。

sentences.en: Last year, however, it came into use.
sentences.zh: 然而，去年它投入使用了。

sentences.en: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
sentences.zh: 一百多人一定是被噪音逼离了家园。

sentences.en: I am one of the few people left.
sentences.zh: 我是少数留下来的人之一。

sentences.en: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
sentences.zh: 有时我想这房子会被一架路过的飞机撞倒。

sentences.en: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here.
sentences.zh: 有人给我一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决心留在这里。

sentences.en: Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
sentences.zh: 大家都说我一定疯了，他们可能是对的。

sentences.en: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
sentences.zh: 简是如何收到陌生人的来信的？

sentences.en: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
sentences.zh: 我的女儿简从未想过会收到一个荷兰同龄女孩的来信。

sentences.en: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.
sentences.zh: 去年，我们渡海旅行，简把一张写有她姓名和地址的纸条放进了一个瓶子里。

sentences.en: She threw the bottle into the sea.
sentences.zh: 她把瓶子扔进了海里。

sentences.en: She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
sentences.zh: 她再也没想起这件事，但十个月后，她收到了一个荷兰女孩的来信。

sentences.en: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
sentences.zh: 现在两个女孩定期通信。

sentences.en: However, they have decided to use the post office.
sentences.zh: 然而，她们决定使用邮局。

sentences.en: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
sentences.zh: 信件会贵一点，但肯定会更快到达。

sentences.en: Why is the new house special?
sentences.zh: 这新房子有什么特别之处？

sentences.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我收到了我姐姐的一封信。

sentences.en: She lives in Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 她住在尼日利亚。

sentences.en: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
sentences.zh: 在信中她说她明年将来英国。

sentences.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
sentences.zh: 如果她来了，她会大吃一惊的。

sentences.en: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正住在这乡下一所漂亮的新房子里。

sentences.en: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
sentences.zh: 这所房子的建造在我姐姐离开之前就动工了。

sentences.en: The house was completed five months ago.
sentences.zh: 房子在5个月前就竣工了。

sentences.en: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.
sentences.zh: 我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。

sentences.en: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
sentences.zh: 这所房子有许多大房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。

sentences.en: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.
sentences.zh: 这是一座很现代化的房子，所以有些人觉得它样子很怪。

sentences.en: It must be the only modern house in the district.
sentences.zh: 它肯定是这个地区唯一的一座现代化住宅。

sentences.en: Had the writer's money been stolen?
sentences.zh: 作者的钱被偷了吗？

sentences.en: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
sentences.zh: 我走进旅馆经理的办公室，坐了下来。

sentences.en: I had just lost ￡50 and I felt very upset.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚丢失了50英镑，感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now. '
sentences.zh: “我把钱落在房间里了，”我说，“现在它不在那儿了。”

sentences.en: The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
sentences.zh: 经理深表同情，但他无能为力。

sentences.en: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
sentences.zh: “现在大家都在丢钱，”他说。

sentences.en: He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界，但被一阵敲门声打断了。

sentences.en: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
sentences.zh: 一个女孩走了进来，在他的桌上放了一个信封。

sentences.en: It contained ￡50.
sentences.zh: 里面装着50英镑。

sentences.en: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
sentences.zh: “我在这位先生的房间外面发现了这个，”她说。

sentences.en: 'Well,' I said to the manager,'there is still some honesty in this world!'
sentences.zh: “噢，”我对经理说，“这世界上还是有诚实可言的！”

sentences.en: Do they speak English?
sentences.zh: 他们说英语吗？

sentences.en: Why does the writer not understand the porter?
sentences.zh: 为什么作者听不懂搬运工的话？

sentences.en: I arrived in London at last.
sentences.zh: 我终于抵达伦敦了。

sentences.en: The railway station was big, black and dark.
sentences.zh: 火车站又大，又黑，又暗。

sentences.en: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
sentences.zh: 我不知道去旅馆的路，所以我问了一位搬运工。

sentences.en: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
sentences.zh: 我不仅非常仔细地说英语，而且说得非常清楚。

sentences.en: The porter, however, could not understand me.
sentences.zh: 然而，那个搬运工却听不懂我。

sentences.en: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
sentences.zh: 我重复了我的问题好几次，最后他终于明白了。

sentences.en: he answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
sentences.zh: 他回答了我，但他既说得不慢也不清楚。

sentences.en: 'I am a foreigner,' I said.
sentences.zh: “我是一个外国人，”我说。

sentences.en: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.
sentences.zh: 然后他慢慢地说，但我仍然听不懂他。

sentences.en: My teacher never spoke English like that!
sentences.zh: 我的老师从来没有那样说过英语！

sentences.en: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
sentences.zh: 搬运工和我互相对视，然后笑了。

sentences.en: Then he said something and I understood it.
sentences.zh: 然后他说了一些话，我听懂了。

sentences.en: 'You'll soon learn English!' he said.
sentences.zh: “你很快就会学好英语的！”他说。

sentences.en: I wonder.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑。

sentences.en: In England, each person speaks a different language.
sentences.zh: 在英国，每个人都说着不同的语言。

sentences.en: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!
sentences.zh: 英国人彼此听得懂，但我听不懂他们！

sentences.en: Do they speak English?
sentences.zh: 他们说英语吗？

sentences.en: Who is the student's best critic?
sentences.zh: 谁是学生最好的评论家？

sentences.en: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
sentences.zh: 我是一名艺术生，画了很多画。

sentences.en: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
sentences.zh: 许多人假装他们懂现代艺术。

sentences.en: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'.
sentences.zh: 他们总是告诉你一幅画是“关于”什么的。

sentences.en: Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多画根本就不是“关于”什么的。

sentences.en: They are just pretty patterns.
sentences.zh: 它们只是漂亮的图案。

sentences.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢它们的方式，就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

sentences.en: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我认为小孩子往往比任何人都更能欣赏现代画。

sentences.en: They notice more.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到更多。

sentences.en: My sister is only seven,
sentences.zh: 我的妹妹只有七岁，

sentences.en: but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
sentences.zh: 但她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

sentences.en: She came into my room yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天她进了我的房间。

sentences.en: 'What are you doing?' she asked.
sentences.zh: “你在做什么？”她问。

sentences.en: 'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?'
sentences.zh: “我正在把这幅画挂在墙上，”我回答。“这是一幅新画。你喜欢吗？”

sentences.en: She looked at it critically for a moment.
sentences.zh: 她批判性地看了一会儿。

sentences.en: 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
sentences.zh: “还行，”她说，“但这幅画是不是倒着挂的？”

sentences.en: I looked at it again.
sentences.zh: 我又看了一遍。

sentences.en: She was right! It was!
sentences.zh: 她是对的！确实是！

sentences.en: What happened to the boys in the night?
sentences.zh: 晚上男孩们发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
sentences.zh: 下午很晚的时候，男孩们把帐篷搭在了田野中央。

sentences.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
sentences.zh: 这一切刚弄好，他们就在篝火上做了一顿饭。

sentences.en: They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
sentences.zh: 他们都饿了，食物闻起来很香。

sentences.en: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
sentences.zh: 美餐一顿之后，他们围着篝火讲故事，唱歌。

sentences.en: But some time later it began to rain.
sentences.zh: 但过了一会儿，天开始下雨了。

sentences.en: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
sentences.zh: 男孩们感到疲倦了，于是他们熄灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。

sentences.en: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
sentences.zh: 他们的睡袋又暖和又舒服，所以他们都睡得很香。

sentences.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
sentences.zh: 半夜里，两个男孩醒了，开始大叫起来。

sentences.en: The tent was full of water!
sentences.zh: 帐篷里全是水！

sentences.en: They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
sentences.zh: 他们都跳出睡袋，匆匆忙忙跑到了外面。

sentences.en: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
sentences.zh: 雨下得很大，他们发现田野里形成了一条小溪。

sentences.en: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
sentences.zh: 小溪蜿蜒穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷下面流过！

sentences.en: What is Jasper White's problem?
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特有什么问题？

sentences.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特是那种相信古代神话的稀有人物之一。

sentences.en: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
sentences.zh: 他刚在城里买了新房子，但自从他搬进来后，他就一直被汽车和它们的车主所困扰。

sentences.en: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
sentences.zh: 每当他晚上回家时，他总是发现有人把车停在他家门口。

sentences.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
sentences.zh: 因此，他甚至一次都没能把自己的车开进车库。

sentences.en: Harrison got a shock.
sentences.zh: 哈里森感到很震惊。

sentences.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
sentences.zh: 他的举动就好像他以前从未在英国生活过一样。

sentences.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
sentences.zh: 最终，他再也忍受不了了。

sentences.en: He had hardly had time to settle down
sentences.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来，

sentences.en: when he sold the house and left the country.
sentences.zh: 就把房子卖掉离开了英国。

sentences.en: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
sentences.zh: 他多年的梦想就这样破灭了。

sentences.en: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
sentences.zh: 哈里森把什么都考虑到了，就是没想到天气。

sentences.en: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特先生为什么给米林顿医生打电话？

sentences.en: While John Gilbert was in hospital,
sentences.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院期间，

sentences.en: he asked his doctor to tell him
sentences.zh: 他请医生告诉他

sentences.en: whether his operation had been successful,
sentences.zh: 他的手术是否成功，

sentences.en: but the doctor refused to do so.
sentences.zh: 但医生拒绝了。

sentences.en: The following day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
sentences.zh: 病人要了一部床头电话。

sentences.en: When he was alone,
sentences.zh: 他独处时，

sentences.en: he telephoned the hospital exchange
sentences.zh: 他给医院总机打电话

sentences.en: and asked for Doctor Millington.
sentences.zh: 要求找米林顿医生。

sentences.en: When the doctor answered the phone,
sentences.zh: 医生接电话后，

sentences.en: Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient,
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特先生说他正在询问一位病人，

sentences.en: a Mr. John Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特先生。

sentences.en: He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful
sentences.zh: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功，

sentences.en: and the doctor told him that it had been.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉他成功了。

sentences.en: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to
sentences.zh: 他又问吉尔伯特先生何时可以

sentences.en: go home and the doctor told him
sentences.zh: 回家，医生告诉他

sentences.en: that he would have to stay
sentences.zh: 他必须在医院

sentences.en: in hospital for another two weeks.
sentences.zh: 再住两周。

sentences.en: Then Dr. Millington asked the caller
sentences.zh: 接着米林顿医生问打电话的人

sentences.en: if he was a relative of the patient.
sentences.zh: 他是不是病人的亲属。

sentences.en: 'No,' the patient answered,
sentences.zh: “不，”病人回答说，

sentences.en: 'I am Mr. John Gilbert.'
sentences.zh: “我就是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”

sentences.en: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
sentences.zh: 伦布尔德夫人是个好的晚餐伴侣吗？

sentences.en: Last week at a dinner party,
sentences.zh: 上周在一个晚宴上，

sentences.en: the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
sentences.zh: 女主人请我坐在伦布尔德夫人旁边。

sentences.en: Mrs. Rumbold was a large,
sentences.zh: 伦布尔德夫人是个身材魁梧、

sentences.en: unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
sentences.zh: 不苟言笑的女士，穿着一件紧身黑连衣裙。

sentences.en: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
sentences.zh: 我在她身边坐下时，她甚至没有抬头看我。

sentences.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time,
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿，

sentences.en: she was busy eating.
sentences.zh: 她就开始大吃起来。

sentences.en: I tried to make conversation.
sentences.zh: 我试图和她攀谈。

sentences.en: 'A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,'
sentences.zh: “一部新戏很快就要在‘环球剧场’上演了，”

sentences.en: I said. 'Will you be seeing it?'
sentences.zh: 我说，“您会去看吗？”

sentences.en: 'No,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “不，”她答道。

sentences.en: 'Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “今年您会到国外度假吗？”我问。

sentences.en: 'No,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “不，”她答道。

sentences.en: 'Will you be staying in England?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “您会留在英格兰吗？”我问。

sentences.en: 'No,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “不，”她答道。

sentences.en: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
sentences.zh: 绝望中，我问她是否喜欢她的晚餐。

sentences.en: 'Young man,' she answered,
sentences.zh: “年轻人，”她回答说，

sentences.en: 'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
sentences.zh: “如果你多吃点，少说点，我们俩都会享受晚餐的！”

lessons.title: Do You Call That a Hat

sentences.en: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你认为作者喜欢哪种购物方式？

sentences.en: 'Do you call that a hat?' I said to my wife.
sentences.zh: “你管那玩意儿叫帽子？”我对妻子说。

sentences.en: 'You needn't be so rude about it,'
sentences.zh: “你没必要这么粗鲁，”

sentences.en: my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
sentences.zh: 妻子对着镜子看着自己，回答道。

sentences.en: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
sentences.zh: 我坐在一把带洞的现代椅子上，等着。

sentences.en: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在帽子店里待了半个小时了，妻子还在镜子前面。

sentences.en: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly.
sentences.zh: “我们不该买不需要的东西，”我突然说道。

sentences.en: I regretted saying it almost at once.
sentences.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了这句话。

sentences.en: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered.
sentences.zh: “你本没必要说那些话的，”妻子回答道。

sentences.en: 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.'
sentences.zh: “我也没必要提醒你昨天买的那条糟糕的领带。”

sentences.en: 'I find it beautiful,' I said. 'A man can never have too many ties.'
sentences.zh: “我觉得它很漂亮，”我说，“男人永远不嫌领带多。”

sentences.en: 'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “女人也永远不嫌帽子多，”她回答道。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
sentences.zh: 十分种后，我们一起走出了商店。

sentences.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
sentences.zh: 妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔一样的帽子！

sentences.en: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
sentences.zh: 耍蛇人开始演奏爵士乐时发生了什么？

sentences.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi,
sentences.zh: 我们在老德里的一处市场走了很长一段路之后，

sentences.en: we stopped at a square to have a rest.
sentences.zh: 在一个广场停下来休息。

sentences.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的另一边有位耍蛇人，

sentences.en: two large baskets at the other side of the square,
sentences.zh: 带着两个大篮子。

sentences.en: so we went to have a look at him.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走过去看他。

sentences.en: As soon as he saw us,
sentences.zh: 他一看到我们，

sentences.en: he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
sentences.zh: 便拿起一根盖满硬币的长笛，打开了一个篮子。

sentences.en: When he began to play a tune,
sentences.zh: 当他开始吹奏曲子时，

sentences.en: we had our first glimpse of the snake.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。

sentences.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
sentences.zh: 它从篮子里钻出来，开始跟着长笛的动作舞动。

sentences.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer
sentences.zh: 当耍蛇人突然开始演奏爵士乐和现代流行歌曲时，

sentences.en: suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
sentences.zh: 我们感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
sentences.zh: 然而，那条蛇却继续缓慢地“跳舞”。

sentences.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
sentences.zh: 它显然分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！

sentences.en: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
sentences.zh: 飞机是如何能够越过山脉的？

sentences.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole,
sentences.zh: 1929年，在他飞越北极三年后，

sentences.en: the American explorer, R.E. Byrd,
sentences.zh: 美国探险家R.E.伯德，

sentences.en: successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
sentences.zh: 首次成功飞越了南极。

sentences.en: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a
sentences.zh: 虽然起初，伯德和他的队员们能够拍摄到

sentences.en: great many photographs of the mountains that lay below,
sentences.zh: 许多下方山脉的照片，

sentences.en: they soon ran into serious trouble.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快就遇到了严重的麻烦。

sentences.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
sentences.zh: 有一刻，他们的飞机似乎肯定会坠毁。

sentences.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10, 000 feet.
sentences.zh: 只有当飞机上升到10,000英尺时，才能越过山脉。

sentences.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
sentences.zh: 伯德立即命令他的队员们扔掉两个沉重的食物袋。

sentences.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
sentences.zh: 飞机随后得以升高，并以400英尺的高度越过了山脉。

sentences.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away,
sentences.zh: 伯德现在知道他将能够抵达300英里外的南极，

sentences.en: for there were no more mountains in sight.
sentences.zh: 因为视线中没有更多的山脉了。

sentences.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
sentences.zh: 飞机能够毫不费力地飞越无尽的白色平原。

sentences.en: How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
sentences.zh: 斯特林夫人是如何找回她的包的？

sentences.en: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk
sentences.zh: 安妮·斯特林夫人没有考虑到她所冒的风险，

sentences.en: she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
sentences.zh: 当她穿过森林追赶两个男人时。

sentences.en: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest
sentences.zh: 当她和孩子们在森林边缘野餐时，他们冲了过来，

sentences.en: with her children and tried to steal her handbag.
sentences.zh: 试图偷走她的手提包。

sentences.en: In the struggle, the strap broke and,
sentences.zh: 在搏斗中，包带断了，

sentences.en: with the bag in their possession,
sentences.zh: 包落到了他们手里，

sentences.en: both men started running through the trees.
sentences.zh: 两人便开始穿过树林逃跑。

sentences.en: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
sentences.zh: 斯特林夫人非常生气，她追了上去。

sentences.en: She was soon out of breath,
sentences.zh: 她很快就气喘吁吁，

sentences.en: but she continued to run.
sentences.zh: 但她继续奔跑。

sentences.en: When she caught up with them,
sentences.zh: 当她追上他们时，

sentences.en: she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag,
sentences.zh: 她看到他们已经坐了下来，正在翻看包里的东西，

sentences.en: so she ran straight at them.
sentences.zh: 于是她直接向他们冲过去。

sentences.en: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
sentences.zh: 男人们吓了一跳，扔下包就跑了。

sentences.en: 'The strap needs mending,' said Mrs. Sterling later, 'but they did not steal anything.'
sentences.zh: “包带需要修一下，”斯特林夫人后来表示，“但他们什么也没偷走。”

sentences.en: How did Sam get his money back?
sentences.zh: 萨姆是怎么把钱找回来的？

sentences.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
sentences.zh: 整个村子很快就知道一大笔钱丢了。

sentences.en: Sam Benton, the local butcher,
sentences.zh: 当地屠夫萨姆·本顿

sentences.en: had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
sentences.zh: 在去邮局存钱的路上丢了钱包。

sentences.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers,
sentences.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被村里人捡走了，

sentences.en: but it was not returned to him.
sentences.zh: 但一直没有还给他。

sentences.en: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
sentences.zh: 三个月过去了，一天早上，萨姆在自家门外发现了他的钱包。

sentences.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost,
sentences.zh: 钱包用报纸包着，里面有他丢失的一半钱，

sentences.en: together with a note which said:
sentences.zh: 还有一张纸条，上面写着：

sentences.en: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!'
sentences.zh: “我是个小偷，但只算50%的小偷！”

sentences.en: Two months later,
sentences.zh: 两个月后，

sentences.en: some more money was sent to Sam with another note:
sentences.zh: 又有一些钱连同另一张纸条寄给了萨姆：

sentences.en: 'Only 25 per cent a thief now!'
sentences.zh: “现在我只算25%的小偷了！”

sentences.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，萨姆所有的钱都以这种方式还了回来。

sentences.en: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
sentences.zh: 最后一张纸条写着：“我现在是100%的诚实人！”

sentences.en: What did the man in this story do?
sentences.zh: 这个故事里的男人做了什么？

sentences.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport,
sentences.zh: 当一架从伦敦起飞的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，

sentences.en: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
sentences.zh: 工人们开始卸下一些装有衣服的木箱。

sentences.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
sentences.zh: 没有人能解释其中一个箱子异常沉重的原因。

sentences.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
sentences.zh: 其中一个工人突然想到要打开那个箱子。

sentences.en: He was astonished at what he found.
sentences.zh: 他对自己的发现感到震惊。

sentences.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
sentences.zh: 一个人躺在箱子里，在一堆羊毛制品上面。

sentences.en: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
sentences.zh: 他被发现时非常惊讶，甚至没有试图逃跑。

sentences.en: After he was arrested,
sentences.zh: 他被捕后，

sentences.en: the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
sentences.zh: 这个人承认在飞机离开伦敦之前藏进了箱子里。

sentences.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip,
sentences.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而不舒服的旅行，

sentences.en: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
sentences.zh: 因为他被关在木箱里超过十八个小时。

sentences.en: The man was ordered to pay ￡3, 500 for the cost of the trip.
sentences.zh: 这个人被勒令支付3,500英镑作为旅行费用。

sentences.en: The normal price of a ticket is ￡2, 000!
sentences.zh: 一张机票的正常价格是2,000英镑！

sentences.en: What evidence is there of a ghost?
sentences.zh: 有什么证据证明有鬼？

sentences.en: A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近购买的一家酒吧正在出售。

sentences.en: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
sentences.zh: 汤普森先生打算出售它，因为它闹鬼。

sentences.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，一天晚上他无法入睡

sentences.en: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
sentences.zh: 因为他听到酒吧里传来奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
sentences.zh: 他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动了。

sentences.en: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed,
sentences.zh: 虽然汤普森先生睡前关了灯，

sentences.en: they were on in the morning.
sentences.zh: 但早上却亮着。

sentences.en: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles
sentences.zh: 他还说他发现了五个空威士忌酒瓶，

sentences.en: which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
sentences.zh: 一定是那个鬼前一天晚上喝光的。

sentences.en: When I suggested that some villagers must have come
sentences.zh: 当我暗示说一定是一些村民过来

sentences.en: in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
sentences.zh: 免费喝酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。

sentences.en: The villagers have told him that
sentences.zh: 村民们告诉他，

sentences.en: they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
sentences.zh: 即使他白送，他们也不会接受那家酒吧。

lessons.title: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

sentences.en: Why did the writer become very worried?
sentences.zh: 作者为什么变得非常担心？

sentences.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
sentences.zh: 牙医总是在你无法回答的时候问问题。

sentences.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
sentences.zh: 我的牙医刚刚拔掉我的一颗牙，并让我休息一会儿。

sentences.en: I tried to say something,
sentences.zh: 我试图说些什么，

sentences.en: but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
sentences.zh: 但我的嘴里塞满了棉花。

sentences.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
sentences.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，问我我的收藏是否在增加。

sentences.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
sentences.zh: 然后他问我哥哥怎么样，以及我是否喜欢我在伦敦的新工作。

sentences.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
sentences.zh: 回答这些问题时，我不是点头就是发出奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
sentences.zh: 同时，我的舌头忙着寻找牙齿拔掉后的那个洞。

sentences.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
sentences.zh: 我突然感到非常担心，却什么也说不出来。

sentences.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth,
sentences.zh: 当牙医最终从我嘴里取出棉花时，

sentences.en: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
sentences.zh: 我才得以告诉他他拔错了牙。

sentences.en: How did the dream end?
sentences.zh: 这个梦是怎样结束的呢？

sentences.en: Tired of sleeping on the floor,
sentences.zh: 德黑兰有个年轻人，他睡在地板上，感到厌倦，

sentences.en: a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
sentences.zh: 于是积蓄了好几年，买了一张真正的床。

sentences.en: For the first time in his life,
sentences.zh: 他生平第一次

sentences.en: he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
sentences.zh: 拥有了一张带弹簧和床垫的床，他为此感到十分自豪。

sentences.en: Because the weather was very hot,
sentences.zh: 因为天气很热，

sentences.en: he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
sentences.zh: 他便把床搬到了屋顶上。

sentences.en: He slept very well for the first two nights,
sentences.zh: 头两晚他睡得很好，

sentences.en: but on the third night, a storm blew up.
sentences.zh: 但第三天晚上，暴风雨突然降临。

sentences.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
sentences.zh: 一阵狂风把床从屋顶上刮了下来，摔到了下面的院子里。

sentences.en: The young man did not wake up
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人直到

sentences.en: until the bed had struck the ground.
sentences.zh: 床撞到地上才醒过来。

sentences.en: Although the bed was smashed to pieces,
sentences.zh: 尽管床摔成了碎片，

sentences.en: the man was miraculously unhurt.
sentences.zh: 但那个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。

sentences.en: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
sentences.zh: 他醒来时，仍然躺在床垫上。

sentences.en: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him,
sentences.zh: 他看了一眼周围的木头和金属碎片，

sentences.en: the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
sentences.zh: 伤心地抱起床垫，把它搬进了屋里。

sentences.en: After he had put it on the floor,
sentences.zh: 他把床垫放到地板上，

sentences.en: he promptly went to sleep again.
sentences.zh: 便很快又睡着了。

sentences.en: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
sentences.zh: 为什么作者没有在伍德福德格林下车？

sentences.en: I love travelling in the country,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在乡下旅行，

sentences.en: but I don't like losing my way.
sentences.zh: 但我不喜欢迷路。

sentences.en: I went on an excursion recently,
sentences.zh: 我最近去了一次短途旅行，

sentences.en: but my trip took me longer than I expected.
sentences.zh: 但我的旅程比我预期的要长。

sentences.en: 'I'm going to Woodford Green,'
sentences.zh: “我要去伍德福德格林，”

sentences.en: I said to the conductor as I got on the bus,
sentences.zh: 我上车时对售票员说，

sentences.en: 'but I don't know where it is.'
sentences.zh: “但我不知道它在哪里。”

sentences.en: 'I'll tell you where to get off.' answered the conductor.
sentences.zh: “我会告诉你哪里下车。”售票员回答。

sentences.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我坐在巴士前排，以便更好地欣赏乡村景色。

sentences.en: After some time, the bus stopped.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，巴士停了下来。

sentences.en: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我环顾四周，震惊地发现我是车上唯一的乘客了。

sentences.en: 'You'll have to get off here,'
sentences.zh: “你必须在这里下车，”

sentences.en: the conductor said. 'This is as far as we go.'
sentences.zh: 售票员说。“我们只能到这里了。”

sentences.en: 'Is this Woodford Green?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “这是伍德福德格林吗？”我问道。

sentences.en: 'Oh dear,' said the conductor suddenly.
sentences.zh: “哦，天哪，”售票员突然说道。

sentences.en: 'I forgot to put you off.'
sentences.zh: “我忘了让你下车了。”

sentences.en: 'It doesn't matter,' I said. 'I'll get off here.'
sentences.zh: “没关系，”我说，“我就在这里下车。”

sentences.en: 'We're going back now,' said the conductor.
sentences.zh: “我们现在要回去了，”售票员说。

sentences.en: 'Well, in that case,
sentences.zh: “好吧，既然如此，”

sentences.en: I prefer to stay on the bus,' I answered.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿留在车上，”我回答道。

sentences.en: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
sentences.zh: 休的节食为什么没有成功？

sentences.en: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat,
sentences.zh: 我的朋友休一直很胖，

sentences.en: but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
sentences.zh: 但最近情况变得如此糟糕，以至于他决定节食。

sentences.en: He began his diet a week ago.
sentences.zh: 他一周前开始节食。

sentences.en: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
sentences.zh: 首先，他列出了一长串所有被禁止的食物。

sentences.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves:
sentences.zh: 清单上包括了休喜欢的大部分东西：

sentences.en: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
sentences.zh: 黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。

sentences.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
sentences.zh: 昨天我去看望了他。

sentences.en: I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
sentences.zh: 我按响了门铃，毫不意外地看到休仍然和以前一样胖。

sentences.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
sentences.zh: 他把我带进他的房间，然后匆忙地把一个大包裹藏到书桌下。

sentences.en: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 显然他感到非常尴尬。

sentences.en: When I asked him what he was doing,
sentences.zh: 当我问他在做什么时，

sentences.en: he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
sentences.zh: 他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放在了书桌上。

sentences.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
sentences.zh: 他解释说他的节食计划太严格了，所以他偶尔需要奖励一下自己。

sentences.en: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
sentences.zh: 接着他给我看了包裹里的东西。

sentences.en: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
sentences.zh: 里面有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！

sentences.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
sentences.zh: 作者的地毯是用什么做的？

sentences.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
sentences.zh: 我们刚搬进一所新房子，我一上午都在忙碌着。

sentences.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
sentences.zh: 我一直想把我的新房间整理好。

sentences.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
sentences.zh: 这可不容易，因为我拥有一千多本书。

sentences.en: To make matters worse,
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，

sentences.en: the room is rather small,
sentences.zh: 房间相当小，

sentences.en: so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以我只好暂时把书放在地板上。

sentences.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space
sentences.zh: 这会儿，它们覆盖了地板上的每一寸地方，

sentences.en: and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
sentences.zh: 我实际上得踩着它们才能进出房间。

sentences.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 不久前，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书柜搬上了楼。

sentences.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她走进我的房间，当她看到地板上所有的书时，大吃一惊。

sentences.en: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,' she said.
sentences.zh: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯了，”她说。

sentences.en: She gazed at it for some time then added,
sentences.zh: 她凝视了一会儿，然后补充说，

sentences.en: 'You don't need bookcases at all.
sentences.zh: “你根本不需要书柜。

sentences.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!'
sentences.zh: 你可以在业余时间坐在这里，读读这地毯！”

sentences.en: What caused the fire?
sentences.zh: 火灾是由什么引起的？

sentences.en: At last fireman have put out a big forest fire in California.
sentences.zh: 消防队员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚州的一场森林大火。

sentences.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们一直在努力查明火灾是如何开始的。

sentences.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
sentences.zh: 森林火灾通常是由碎玻璃或人们随意丢弃的烟头引起的。

sentences.en: Yesterday the fireman examined the ground carefully,
sentences.zh: 昨天消防队员仔细检查了地面，

sentences.en: but were not able to find any broken glass.
sentences.zh: 但没能找到任何碎玻璃。

sentences.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们也相当确定不是烟头引起的火灾。

sentences.en: This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天早上，一名消防队员偶然发现了起火原因。

sentences.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.
sentences.zh: 他发现了一条缠绕在16000伏高压电线上的蛇的残骸。

sentences.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
sentences.zh: 就这样，他解开了这个谜团。

sentences.en: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
sentences.zh: 解释很简单，但非常不同寻常。

sentences.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟从地上抓起这条蛇，然后把它掉到了电线上。

sentences.en: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
sentences.zh: 然后蛇缠绕在电线上。

sentences.en: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
sentences.zh: 当它这样做时，它向地面发出了火花，这些火花立刻引发了一场火灾。

sentences.en: What two interruptions did the writer have?
sentences.zh: 作者遇到了哪两次打扰？

sentences.en: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
sentences.zh: 早饭后，我把孩子们送到学校，然后就去商店了。

sentences.en: It was still early when I returned home.
sentences.zh: 我回到家时，时间还早。

sentences.en: The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在学校，我丈夫去上班了，家里很安静。

sentences.en: So I decided to make some meat pies.
sentences.zh: 于是我决定做些肉馅饼。

sentences.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我就忙着搅和黄油

sentences.en: and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
sentences.zh: 和面粉，很快我的手上就沾满了黏糊糊的面团。

sentences.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，电话铃响了。

sentences.en: Nothing could have been more annoying.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更烦人的了。

sentences.en: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
sentences.zh: 我用两根黏糊糊的手指拿起听筒，当认出海伦·贝茨的声音时，我感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last I hung up the receiver.
sentences.zh: 我花了十分钟才说服她稍后再打来。最后我挂断了电话。

sentences.en: What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
sentences.zh: 真是一团糟！我的手指上、电话上、门把手上都沾满了面团。

sentences.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
sentences.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大得足以把死人吵醒。

sentences.en: This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
sentences.zh: 这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信！

sentences.en: What did the team find?
sentences.zh: 团队发现了什么？

sentences.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
sentences.zh: 最近，寻找失落宝藏的梦想差点成真。

sentences.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented
sentences.zh: 一种名为“揭示者”的新机器被发明出来

sentences.en: and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
sentences.zh: 并且它被用来探测埋在地下的黄金。

sentences.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where--it is said--pirates used to hide gold.
sentences.zh: 这台机器被用在海边的一个洞穴里，据说海盗曾在那儿藏匿黄金。

sentences.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
sentences.zh: 海盗们经常把黄金埋在洞穴里，然后却未能取走。

sentences.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
sentences.zh: 带着这台新机器，一支搜索队进入洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

sentences.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
sentences.zh: 当机器显示地下有黄金时，搜索队的队长正在检查洞穴入口附近的泥土。

sentences.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
sentences.zh: 队员们非常兴奋，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

sentences.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
sentences.zh: 他们最终发现了一枚几乎毫无价值的小金币。

sentences.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
sentences.zh: 随后，队员们彻底搜查了整个洞穴，但除了一个空锡箱外什么也没找到。

sentences.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信，“揭示者”很快会揭示出一些有价值的东西。

sentences.en: How fast did the winning car go?
sentences.zh: 获胜的赛车开得有多快？

sentences.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
sentences.zh: 每年一度，都会举行一次老爷车比赛。

sentences.en: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
sentences.zh: 去年，许多汽车报名参加了这场比赛，比赛开始前气氛异常热烈。

sentences.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
sentences.zh: 其中一辆最漂亮的车是劳斯莱斯“银灵”。

sentences.en: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
sentences.zh: 最不寻常的车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰车。

sentences.en: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
sentences.zh: 它建于1885年，是参赛车辆中最老的一辆。

sentences.en: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.
sentences.zh: 在一阵阵巨大的轰鸣声之后，比赛开始了。

sentences.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
sentences.zh: 许多汽车在赛道上抛锚了，有些司机待在车底的时间比待在车里的时间还长！

sentences.en: A few cars, however, completed the race.
sentences.zh: 然而，有几辆车完成了比赛。

sentences.en: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour -- much faster than any of its rivals.
sentences.zh: 获胜的赛车达到了每小时40英里的速度——比任何竞争对手都要快得多。

sentences.en: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
sentences.zh: 在比赛结束时，它向下冲刺，司机费了很大的劲才把它停下来。

sentences.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这场比赛给每个人带来了极大的乐趣。

sentences.en: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
sentences.zh: 它与现代汽车比赛大相径庭，但同样激动人心。

sentences.en: Did the woman get what she wanted?
sentences.zh: 女人得到了她想要的吗？

sentences.en: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
sentences.zh: 一个穿着牛仔裤的女人站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。

sentences.en: Though she hesitated for a moment,
sentences.zh: 尽管她犹豫了片刻，

sentences.en: she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
sentences.zh: 但她最终还是走了进去，要求看一件陈列在橱窗里的连衣裙。

sentences.en: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
sentences.zh: 接待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着打扮。

sentences.en: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
sentences.zh: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，告诉她那件连衣裙已经卖掉了。

sentences.en: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
sentences.zh: 女人气愤地走出商店，决定第二天惩罚那个店员。

sentences.en: She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat,
sentences.zh: 第二天上午，她回到店里，穿了一件裘皮大衣，

sentences.en: with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
sentences.zh: 一只手拿着坤包，另一只手拿着一把长柄伞。

sentences.en: After seeking out the rude assistant,
sentences.zh: 找到那个无礼的店员后，

sentences.en: she asked for the same dress.
sentences.zh: 她又问起那件连衣裙。

sentences.en: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
sentences.zh: 店员没有认出她，这次却殷勤地为她服务。

sentences.en: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
sentences.zh: 他费了很大的劲儿才爬进橱窗去取那件连衣裙。

sentences.en: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
sentences.zh: 她一看就说不喜欢。

sentences.en: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window
sentences.zh: 她让店员把橱窗里几乎所有的东西都拿出来，

sentences.en: before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
sentences.zh: 最后才买了她第一次看中的那件连衣裙，以此来取乐。

sentences.en: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
sentences.zh: 为什么牧师拒绝砍掉这棵树？

sentences.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
sentences.zh: 弗林利这个小村庄据说有一棵“被诅咒的树”。

sentences.en: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper,
sentences.zh: 因为这棵树在报纸上被提及，

sentences.en: the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
sentences.zh: 弗林利的游客数量现在增加了。

sentences.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
sentences.zh: 这棵树是五十年前种在教堂附近的，但直到最近几年才声名狼藉。

sentences.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
sentences.zh: 据说如果任何人触摸这棵树，他就会有厄运；如果他摘一片叶子，他就会死去。

sentences.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
sentences.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经夺走了许多受害者的生命。

sentences.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
sentences.zh: 牧师被要求砍掉这棵树，但到目前为止他一直拒绝。

sentences.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income,
sentences.zh: 他指出这棵树是一个有用的收入来源，

sentences.en: as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
sentences.zh: 因为游客们从全国各地赶来参观它。

sentences.en: In spite of all that has been said,
sentences.zh: 尽管有各种说法，

sentences.en: the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
sentences.zh: 游客们一直在摘叶子并在树干上刻下他们的名字。

sentences.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他们中没有一个人被突然死亡击倒！

sentences.en: Why did Rex run away?
sentences.zh: 雷克斯为什么跑了？

sentences.en: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
sentences.zh: 我们的狗雷克斯，过去常常坐在前门外面吠叫。

sentences.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
sentences.zh: 每次他想进花园时，都会吠叫，直到有人把门打开。

sentences.en: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
sentences.zh: 由于邻居们抱怨噪音，我丈夫花了几周时间训练他用爪子按压门闩，好让他自己进来。

sentences.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的专家。

sentences.en: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
sentences.zh: 然而，上周我外出购物时，注意到他在花园里，靠近门的地方。

sentences.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
sentences.zh: 这次他在吠叫，好让有人把他放出去！

sentences.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他又养成了一个坏习惯。

sentences.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
sentences.zh: 他一从外面打开门，就走进花园，然后等着门关上。

sentences.en: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
sentences.zh: 然后他坐着吠叫，直到有人把他放出去。

sentences.en: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
sentences.zh: 之后他立刻自己进来，又开始吠叫。

sentences.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
sentences.zh: 昨天我丈夫把门拆掉了，雷克斯非常生气，从那以后我们就再也没见过他了。

sentences.en: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
sentences.zh: 贝林斯基夫人说的会成真吗？

sentences.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
sentences.zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位名叫贝林斯基夫人的算命师。

sentences.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
sentences.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她叫我坐下。

sentences.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said:
sentences.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她看着水晶球说：

sentences.en: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
sentences.zh: “你的一位亲戚要来看你。

sentences.en: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
sentences.zh: 她今晚会到，打算住几天。

sentences.en: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 你一离开这个帐篷，就会有一个大惊喜。

sentences.en: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
sentences.zh: 一位你很熟悉的女人会向你跑来。

sentences.en: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.'
sentences.zh: 她会和你说话，然后带你离开这个地方。就这些了。”

sentences.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
sentences.zh: 我一出去，就完全把贝林斯基夫人忘在脑后了，因为我妻子匆匆向我走来。

sentences.en: 'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently.
sentences.zh: “你躲到哪里去了？”她不耐烦地问。

sentences.en: 'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.'
sentences.zh: “你妹妹不到一小时就要到了，我们必须去车站接她。我们已经迟到了。”

sentences.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
sentences.zh: 她走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。

sentences.en: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
sentences.zh: 望远镜在太空有什么特别的重要性？

sentences.en: The Hubble telescope was launched into
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜是

sentences.en: space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 1990年4月20日由美国宇航局发射升空的，耗资10多亿美元。

sentences.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜从一开始就出了毛病。

sentences.en: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
sentences.zh: 它给我们发回的图片非常令人失望，因为它的主镜有缺陷！

sentences.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
sentences.zh: 美国宇航局现在将把望远镜修复好，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
sentences.zh: 所以它很快将派4名宇航员上去修复它。

sentences.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃。

sentences.en: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号的一个机械臂将抓住望远镜并将其固定住，而宇航员则进行必要的修理。

sentences.en: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
sentences.zh: 当然，哈勃望远镜处于地球大气层之外，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 所以它很快将给我们发回我们从未见过的最清晰的恒星和遥远星系的图片。

sentences.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们许多关于宇宙的年龄和大小的信息。

sentences.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
sentences.zh: 当你读到这里时，哈勃的“鹰眼”将已经给我们发回了成千上万张精彩的图片。

sentences.en: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
sentences.zh: 火灾过后，村庄面临的危险是什么？

sentences.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
sentences.zh: 消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才把火势控制住。

sentences.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
sentences.zh: 不久前，大树还覆盖着周围几英里长的乡村。

sentences.en: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
sentences.zh: 如今，烟雾依然从荒凉山丘的温暖地面上冉冉升起。

sentences.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction,
sentences.zh: 冬天快到了，这些山丘威胁着周围的村庄，要将它们毁灭，

sentences.en: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
sentences.zh: 因为大雨不仅会冲走泥土，还会引起严重的水灾。

sentences.en: When the fire had at last been put out,
sentences.zh: 大火最终被扑灭后，

sentences.en: the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
sentences.zh: 森林管理机构订购了几吨很快就能生长的特殊草籽。

sentences.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
sentences.zh: 草籽由飞机大量地撒向地面。

sentences.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
sentences.zh: 飞机撒播草籽将近一个月后，天下起了雨。

sentences.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
sentences.zh: 然而，到那时许多地方的草已经生根了。

sentences.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
sentences.zh: 原本在那里生长了几个世纪的大树，

sentences.en: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
sentences.zh: 如今在焦黑的泥土上开始出现一片片绿色。

sentences.en: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?
sentences.zh: 珍妮为什么想离开婚宴？

sentences.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·汉普顿交友甚广，在聚会上很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour--everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
sentences.zh: 人人都羡慕他那绝妙的幽默感——人人都羡慕，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮。

sentences.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
sentences.zh: 最近，杰里米的一位最亲密的朋友请他在一个婚宴上讲话。

sentences.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
sentences.zh: 这正是杰里米喜欢做的事情。

sentences.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
sentences.zh: 他精心准备了演讲稿，并和珍妮一起去了婚礼。

sentences.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中讲了许多有趣的故事，当然，演讲非常成功。

sentences.en: As soon as he had finished Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
sentences.zh: 演讲刚一结束，珍妮就告诉他她想回家。

sentences.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
sentences.zh: 杰里米对此有点失望，但他还是照他女儿的要求做了。

sentences.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢那个演讲。

sentences.en: To his surprise she said she hadn't.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她说她不喜欢。

sentences.en: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
sentences.zh: 杰里米问她为什么不喜欢，她告诉他她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他！

sentences.en: Why was the first tunnel not completed?
sentences.zh: 为什么第一条隧道没有建成？

sentences.en: In 1858, a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond,
sentences.zh: 1858年，一位名叫埃梅·托梅·德·加蒙的法国工程师，

sentences.en: arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
sentences.zh: 带着修建一条21英里长的英吉利海峡隧道的计划抵达英国。

sentences.en: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
sentences.zh: 他说可以在海峡中央修建一个平台。

sentences.en: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
sentences.zh: 这个平台将作为港口和火车站。

sentences.en: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
sentences.zh: 如果在海平面以上修建高烟囱，隧道将能很好地通风。

sentences.en: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.
sentences.zh: 1860年，英国人威廉·洛提出了一个更好的方案。

sentences.en: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.
sentences.zh: 他建议修建一条双轨铁路隧道。

sentences.en: This would solve the problem of ventilation for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.
sentences.zh: 这将解决通风问题，因为如果火车进入这条隧道，它会从后面吸入新鲜空气。

sentences.en: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.
sentences.zh: 四十二年后，一条隧道实际开始动工。

sentences.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
sentences.zh: 如果当时英国人没有害怕入侵，它就会建成。

sentences.en: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.
sentences.zh: 世界不得不又等了将近100年才等到英吉利海峡隧道。

sentences.en: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
sentences.zh: 它于1994年3月7日正式开通，最终将英国与欧洲大陆连接起来。

sentences.en: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
sentences.zh: 为什么警察不得不把Jumbo从大街上推开？

sentences.en: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
sentences.zh: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。

sentences.en: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls,
sentences.zh: 他打扮成圣诞老人，由六个漂亮女孩组成的“仪仗队”陪同，

sentences.en: he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
sentences.zh: 骑着一头名叫Jumbo的小象，沿着城市的主街出发了。

sentences.en: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 他本该知道警察绝不会允许这种事情发生。

sentences.en: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
sentences.zh: 一名警察走近吉米，告诉他本该走小巷，因为Jumbo正在阻碍交通。

sentences.en: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
sentences.zh: 尽管吉米同意立即离开，但Jumbo却拒绝移动。

sentences.en: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
sentences.zh: 十五名警察不得不非常用力地推，才把他弄下主街。

sentences.en: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
sentences.zh: 警察们费了好大劲，但他们都觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,' said a policeman afterwards,
sentences.zh: “Jumbo肯定有几吨重，”一名警察事后说，

sentences.en: 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
sentences.zh: “所以我们不必抬他真是幸运。

sentences.en: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.'
sentences.zh: 当然，我们应该逮捕他，但鉴于他表现良好，这次我们就放过他了。”

sentences.en: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
sentences.zh: 什么是“甜如蜂蜜”以及为什么？

sentences.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
sentences.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在沃利斯岛，

sentences.en: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
sentences.zh: 一个位于南太平洋的偏远地方，在萨摩亚以西很远。

sentences.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
sentences.zh: 飞机没有损坏得太严重，

sentences.en: but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，这次坠机事件被遗忘，残骸也一直未被触动。

sentences.en: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
sentences.zh: 1989年，坠机26年后，在一项对该岛的空中勘测中，这架飞机被意外重新发现。

sentences.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
sentences.zh: 此时，一架状况尚可的兰开斯特轰炸机已属罕见，值得营救。

sentences.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
sentences.zh: 法国当局将飞机打包，并分批运回法国。

sentences.en: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
sentences.zh: 现在，一群爱好者正准备修复这架飞机。

sentences.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 它有四台劳斯莱斯梅林发动机，但该团队只需要重建其中三台。

sentences.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
sentences.zh: 想象一下，当他们打开包装箱时，是多么惊喜和高兴，

sentences.en: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
sentences.zh: 发现第四台发动机“甜如蜂蜜”——仍然处于完美状态。

sentences.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
sentences.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了一个蜂巢，它完全被蜂蜡保存了下来！

sentences.en: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
sentences.zh: 为什么塔齐耶夫要这样冒生命危险？

sentences.en: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 波兰科学家哈伦·塔齐耶夫一生都在研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。

sentences.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
sentences.zh: 1948年，他去了刚果的基伍湖，观察一座新火山，他后来将其命名为基图罗。

sentences.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
sentences.zh: 塔齐耶夫在火山猛烈喷发时，能够把营地设在离火山很近的地方。

sentences.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
sentences.zh: 尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。

sentences.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
sentences.zh: 他注意到一条液态岩石的河流正向他涌来。

sentences.en: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
sentences.zh: 它威胁要将他完全包围，但塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

sentences.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
sentences.zh: 他等到火山平静下来，两天后才得以返回。

sentences.en: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
sentences.zh: 这次，他设法爬进了基图罗的火山口，以便拍照和测量温度。

sentences.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
sentences.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒生命危险。

sentences.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
sentences.zh: 他比任何在世的人都能告诉我们更多关于活火山的信息。

sentences.en: Why did Elizabeth tell Nigel that she was going to the dentist?
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白为什么告诉奈杰尔她要去看牙医？

sentences.en: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him but he saw me and came running towards me.
sentences.zh: 我穿过街道，想避开他，但他看见了我，朝我跑过来。

sentences.en: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
sentences.zh: 假装没看见他也没用，所以我朝他挥了挥手。

sentences.en: I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes.
sentences.zh: 我从不喜欢遇到奈杰尔·戴克斯。

sentences.en: He never has anything to do.
sentences.zh: 他从没有什么事可做。

sentences.en: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
sentences.zh: 不管你有多忙，他总是坚持要和你一起去。

sentences.en: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
sentences.zh: 我得想个办法阻止他整个上午跟着我。

sentences.en: 'Hello, Nigel,' I said 'Fancy meeting you here!'
sentences.zh: “你好，奈杰尔，”我说，“真巧在这儿见到你！”

sentences.en: 'Hi, Elizabeth,' Nigel answered. 'I was just wondering how to spend the morning--until I saw you.
sentences.zh: “嗨，伊丽莎白，”奈杰尔回答，“我刚才还在想怎么打发这个上午呢——直到我看见你。

sentences.en: You're not busy doing anything, are you?'
sentences.zh: 你没什么事要做吧，是吗？”

sentences.en: 'No, not at all,' I answered. 'I'm going to...'
sentences.zh: “不，一点也不忙，”我回答，“我要去……”
