sentences.en: 'Would you mind my coming with you?' he asked, before I had finished speaking.
sentences.zh: “你介意我跟你一起去吗？”他没等我说完就问道。

sentences.en: 'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm going to the dentist.'
sentences.zh: “一点也不，”我撒谎说，“不过我要去看牙医。”

sentences.en: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.
sentences.zh: “那我跟你一起去，”他回答道。

sentences.en: 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!'
sentences.zh: “候诊室里总是有很多东西可以读的！”

sentences.en: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?
sentences.zh: 你认为作者通过驾照考试了吗？为什么？

sentences.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
sentences.zh: 我第三次参加驾驶执照考试。

sentences.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
sentences.zh: 我被要求在车辆很多的道路上驾驶，并成功完成了。

sentences.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
sentences.zh: 在被指示开出市区后，我开始有了信心。

sentences.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
sentences.zh: 确信我已通过，我几乎开始享受我的考试了。

sentences.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing Mr. Eames.
sentences.zh: 考官一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着说：“还有一件事，伊姆斯先生。

sentences.en: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
sentences.zh: 假设有个孩子突然从你车前跑过。

sentences.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.'
sentences.zh: 我一敲车窗，你必须在五英尺内把车停住。”

sentences.en: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.
sentences.zh: 我继续驾驶，过了一会儿，考官大声敲击车窗。

sentences.en: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.
sentences.zh: 尽管声音听得很清楚，但我过了好一会儿才做出反应。

sentences.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
sentences.zh: 我猛地踩下刹车踏板，结果我们俩都被猛地向前甩去。

sentences.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
sentences.zh: 考官悲伤地看着我。

sentences.en: 'Mr. Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
sentences.zh: “伊姆斯先生，”他用悲哀的声音说，“你刚才把那个孩子撞死了！”

sentences.en: How was the drunk removed from the ring?
sentences.zh: 醉汉是怎样被弄出斗牛场的？

sentences.en: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
sentences.zh: 在一场斗牛中，一个醉汉突然晃晃悠悠地走进斗牛场中央。

sentences.en: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
sentences.zh: 观众开始大叫，但醉汉全然不知危险。

sentences.en: The bull was busy with the matador at the time,
sentences.zh: 那时，公牛正忙着对付斗牛士，

sentences.en: but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
sentences.zh: 但它突然发现那个醉汉正在大声说粗话，挥舞着一顶红帽子。

sentences.en: Apparently sensitive to criticism,
sentences.zh: 显然，公牛对批评很敏感，

sentences.en: the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
sentences.zh: 它把斗牛士忘得一干二净，径直向醉汉冲去。

sentences.en: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
sentences.zh: 观众突然鸦雀无声。

sentences.en: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
sentences.zh: 然而，那醉汉好像十分自信。

sentences.en: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
sentences.zh: 当公牛冲到他身边时，他笨拙地闪到一边，让公牛过去。

sentences.en: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
sentences.zh: 观众爆发出阵阵喝彩声，醉汉则鞠躬致意。

sentences.en: By this time, however three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，3个人走进斗牛场，他们迅速把醉汉拖到安全地带。

sentences.en: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him,
sentences.zh: 好像连公牛都为他感到惋惜，

sentences.en: for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
sentences.zh: 它一直同情地看着，直到醉汉离开场地才再次把注意力转向斗牛士。

sentences.en: Has Big Ben ever gone wrong?
sentences.zh: 大本钟出过错吗？

sentences.en: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben,
sentences.zh: 当你游览伦敦时，首先会看到的是大本钟，

sentences.en: the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
sentences.zh: 这个著名的钟，在BBC广播中全世界都能听到。

sentences.en: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834,
sentences.zh: 如果议会大厦在1834年没有被烧毁的话，

sentences.en: the great clock would never have been erected.
sentences.zh: 这个大钟就永远不会被建造。

sentences.en: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
sentences.zh: 大本钟的名字来源于本杰明·霍尔爵士，他在建造新议会大厦时负责制造这个钟。

sentences.en: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
sentences.zh: 它不仅体积巨大，而且极其精确。

sentences.en: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
sentences.zh: 格林尼治天文台的官员每天检查这个钟两次。

sentences.en: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
sentences.zh: 在BBC广播中，当大本钟报时时，你可以听到它的声音，因为麦克风连接到了钟楼。

sentences.en: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 大本钟很少出错。

sentences.en: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一次它没能报出正确的时间。

sentences.en: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
sentences.zh: 一位在钟楼上工作的画家把一罐颜料挂在了其中一根指针上，把它弄慢了！

sentences.en: What mistake was made?
sentences.zh: 犯了什么错误？

sentences.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士是第一个时速超过300英里的人。

sentences.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
sentences.zh: 他于1935年9月在犹他州博纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。

sentences.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
sentences.zh: 他驾驶的赛车“蓝鸟”是专门为他制造的。

sentences.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2, 500-horsepower engine.
sentences.zh: 它长30多英尺，配有2500马力的发动机。

sentences.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour,
sentences.zh: 尽管坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，

sentences.en: he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
sentences.zh: 但他很难控制赛车，因为在第一次行驶时，一个轮胎爆裂了。

sentences.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 尝试结束后，坎贝尔沮丧地得知他的平均速度是每小时299英里。

sentences.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
sentences.zh: 然而，几天后，他被告知犯了一个错误。

sentences.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 他的平均速度是每小时301英里。

sentences.en: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，赛车手已经达到了每小时600英里以上的速度。

sentences.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
sentences.zh: 许多年后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德也追随父亲的脚步，创造了一项世界纪录。

sentences.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
sentences.zh: 和他父亲一样，他驾驶的也是一辆名为“蓝鸟”的赛车。

sentences.en: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
sentences.zh: 那个男孩去他想去的地方了吗？

sentences.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
sentences.zh: 逃学的孩子都缺乏想象力。

sentences.en: A quiet day's fishing,
sentences.zh: 安静地钓上一天鱼，

sentences.en: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
sentences.zh: 或者在电影院里看8小时的同一部电影，这通常是他们能做到的最大限度了。

sentences.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant travelled 1, 600 miles.
sentences.zh: 然而，一个逃学竟走了1600英里的孩子使他们都相形见绌了。

sentences.en: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他搭便车到了多佛，傍晚时分进了一条船想找个地方睡觉。

sentences.en: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
sentences.zh: 第二天早晨醒来时，他发现那条船已行驶到加来。

sentences.en: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
sentences.zh: 他悄悄溜下船时没人注意到他。

sentences.en: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他又搭上一辆卡车去了巴黎。

sentences.en: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
sentences.zh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，在城外把他放下了。

sentences.en: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would,
sentences.zh: 男孩拦的下一辆车并没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，

sentences.en: but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
sentences.zh: 而是带到了法国和西班牙边境上的佩皮尼昂。

sentences.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
sentences.zh: 在那里他被一个警察发现，然后当地政府把他遣送回了英国。

sentences.en: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
sentences.zh: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。

sentences.en: Why was their disguise 'too perfect' ?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们的伪装“太完美”了？

sentences.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
sentences.zh: 一辆老旧的公共汽车停在一条干涸的河床上，一群著名演员下了车。

sentences.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes,
sentences.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，

sentences.en: they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
sentences.zh: 他们采取了特殊的预防措施，以防被人认出来。

sentences.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快发现，伪装有时会过于完美。

sentences.en: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
sentences.zh: “这里真是个野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格莱姆说。

sentences.en: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
sentences.zh: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯同意道。

sentences.en: 'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'
sentences.zh: “没有记者，没有影迷！我们为什么不常来呢？”

sentences.en: Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，另外两名演员洛克沃尔·斯林格和梅林·格里夫斯，

sentences.en: had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
sentences.zh: 已经把两大篮食物搬到了一片树荫下。

sentences.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
sentences.zh: 当他们都安顿好时，一个陌生人出现了。

sentences.en: He looked very angry.
sentences.zh: 他看起来非常生气。

sentences.en: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
sentences.zh: “你们现在都给我滚出去，你们所有人！”他喊道。

sentences.en: 'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says "No Camping"  -- in case you can't read!'
sentences.zh: “我是这里的治安官。你看到那张告示了吗？上面写着‘禁止露营’——以防你不识字！”

sentences.en: 'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall,
sentences.zh: “看，治安官，”洛克沃尔说，

sentences.en: 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
sentences.zh: “别对我们太严厉。我是洛克沃尔·斯林格，这是梅林·格里夫斯。”

sentences.en: 'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
sentences.zh: “哦，是吗？”治安官嘲讽地说。

sentences.en: 'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam. Now you get out of here fast!'
sentences.zh: “嗯，我是布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格莱姆。你们现在赶紧滚出去！”

sentences.en: How did the woman get help?
sentences.zh: 这位妇女是怎样获得救援的？

sentences.en: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago,
sentences.zh: 前些日子，一架小型客机偏离航线

sentences.en: it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
sentences.zh: 在山区坠毁，飞行员当场丧生。

sentences.en: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
sentences.zh: 唯一的乘客，一位年轻的妇女和她的两个女婴却安然无恙。

sentences.en: It was the middle of winter.
sentences.zh: 那时正值隆冬。

sentences.en: Snow lay thick on the ground.
sentences.zh: 地上覆盖着厚厚的积雪。

sentences.en: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
sentences.zh: 妇女知道最近的村庄也在数英里之外。

sentences.en: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it,
sentences.zh: 天黑时，她把一只手提箱当作小床，把孩子们放了进去，

sentences.en: covering them with all the clothes she could find.
sentences.zh: 又把自己能找到的所有衣服都盖在了她们身上。

sentences.en: During the night, it got terribly cold.
sentences.zh: 夜里，天气变得异常寒冷。

sentences.en: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
sentences.zh: 妇女尽可能地靠近孩子，甚至想自己也钻进箱子里，但箱子太小了。

sentences.en: Early next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天清早，

sentences.en: she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
sentences.zh: 她听到飞机从头顶飞过，心想该如何发出求救信号呢？

sentences.en: Then she had an idea. She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
sentences.zh: 接着她有了一个主意。她在雪地上踩出了“SOS”这几个字母。

sentences.en: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看到了这个信号，并用无线电把消息发给了最近的城镇。

sentences.en: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
sentences.zh: 不久，一架直升机飞抵现场，营救了这次飞机坠毁事故的幸存者。

sentences.en: What was the joke?
sentences.zh: 笑话是什么？

sentences.en: 'To end our special news bulletin,'
sentences.zh: “为结束我们的特别新闻快报，”

sentences.en: said the voice of the television announcer, 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
sentences.zh: 电视播音员的声音说道，“我们现在转向卡拉布里亚的通心粉田。”

sentences.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
sentences.zh: 通心粉在这片区域种植已有六百多年了。

sentences.en: Two of the leading growers Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante,
sentences.zh: 两位主要的种植者朱塞佩·摩尔多瓦和里卡尔多·布拉班特，

sentences.en: tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
sentences.zh: 告诉我他们今年预计会有一个丰收，而且收割比往常开始得早。

sentences.en: Here you can see two workers who, between them,
sentences.zh: 在这里你可以看到两位工人，他们俩，

sentences.en: have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
sentences.zh: 刚砍完了三车金黄色的通心粉茎。

sentences.en: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.
sentences.zh: 整个村庄昼夜不停地收割和脱粒今年的庄稼，以赶在九月雨季之前。

sentences.en: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.
sentences.zh: 在右边，你可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。

sentences.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
sentences.zh: 她已经帮助她的丈夫三十年了。

sentences.en: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
sentences.zh: 布拉班特夫人正在和当地加工庄稼的工厂经理交谈。

sentences.en: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest:
sentences.zh: 这最后一幕向你展示了收割结束后将发生的事情：

sentences.en: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
sentences.zh: 著名的卡拉布里亚通心粉大赛！

sentences.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
sentences.zh: 现任冠军弗拉特利先生自1991年以来每年都赢得了比赛。

sentences.en: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
sentences.zh: 今天的特别快报到此结束，今天是4月1日星期四。

sentences.en: We're now going back to the studio.'
sentences.zh: 我们现在回到演播室。”

sentences.en: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
sentences.zh: 医生们查出这名妇女是怎么死的了吗？

sentences.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
sentences.zh: 一具死于公元前800年的埃及妇女木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。

sentences.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
sentences.zh: 这具木乃伊是谢芬姆特的，她曾是底比斯神庙里的一名歌手。

sentences.en: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy,
sentences.zh: 由于对这具木乃伊X光片上有一些奇怪的印记，

sentences.en: doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
sentences.zh: 医生们一直在设法弄清这名妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。

sentences.en: The only way to do this was to operate.
sentences.zh: 唯一的方法就是进行手术。

sentences.en: The operation, which lasted for over four hours,
sentences.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时，

sentences.en: proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
sentences.zh: 由于木乃伊的皮肤上覆盖着坚硬的树脂，手术做起来非常困难。

sentences.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
sentences.zh: 医生们取走了木乃伊的一小块，并把它送到了实验室。

sentences.en: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现了一些X光片上没有显示出来的东西：一个小的、蜡制的杜穆特夫神像。

sentences.en: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
sentences.zh: 这个长着牛头的神像通常被放置在木乃伊里面。

sentences.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
sentences.zh: 医生们尚未确定这名妇女是如何死亡的。

sentences.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open,
sentences.zh: 他们担心当他们切开木乃伊时，它会碎裂，

sentences.en: but fortunately this has not happened.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
sentences.zh: 这具木乃伊成功地经受住了这次手术。

sentences.en: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
sentences.zh: 作者戒烟戒了多久？

sentences.en: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
sentences.zh: 读了一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章后，我点燃了一支香烟来镇定情绪。

sentences.en: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
sentences.zh: 我聚精会神、津津有味地抽着，因为我确信这是我的最后一支香烟了。

sentences.en: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.
sentences.zh: 整整一个星期我根本没吸烟，在此期间我妻子可遭了大罪了。

sentences.en: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
sentences.zh: 我具备了戒烟者的所有常见症状：脾气暴躁，胃口大开。

sentences.en: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友们不断地给我递香烟和雪茄。

sentences.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
sentences.zh: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰地取笑我。

sentences.en: After seven days of this I went to a party.
sentences.zh: 这样过了7天，我参加了一个聚会。

sentences.en: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我周围的人都在吸烟，我感到非常不舒服。

sentences.en: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
sentences.zh: 当我的老朋友布赖恩极力劝我抽一支烟时，我再也忍不住了。

sentences.en: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 我内疚地拿了一支，点上，心满意足地抽了起来。

sentences.en: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
sentences.zh: 我妻子很高兴一切又恢复了正常。

sentences.en: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
sentences.zh: 不过，正如布赖恩指出的，戒烟是世界上最容易的事情。

sentences.en: He himself has done it lots of times!
sentences.zh: 他自己就戒过好多次了！

sentences.en: Why did the plane turn back?
sentences.zh: 飞机为什么返航了？

sentences.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
sentences.zh: 我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。

sentences.en: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我父母过去住在南美洲，我放假时常从欧洲飞到那里。

sentences.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
sentences.zh: 乘务员会照顾我，我从未有过不愉快的经历。

sentences.en: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
sentences.zh: 我习惯了乘飞机旅行，只有一次感到害怕。

sentences.en: After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height,
sentences.zh: 起飞后，我们低空飞过城市，慢慢爬升，

sentences.en: when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
sentences.zh: 飞机突然掉头飞回了机场。

sentences.en: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm
sentences.zh: 当我们等待降落时，一位乘务员告诉我们要保持冷静，

sentences.en: and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
sentences.zh: 飞机一着陆就安静地下飞机。

sentences.en: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
sentences.zh: 飞机上的每个人都很担心，我们都很好奇发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
sentences.zh: 后来我们得知飞机上有一位非常重要的人物。

sentences.en: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
sentences.zh: 警方接到报告说飞机上被安放了炸弹。

sentences.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 飞机降落后，被彻底搜查了一番。

sentences.en: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，什么也没发现，五小时后我们得以再次起飞。

sentences.en: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?
sentences.zh: 有多少人参观了1851年的万国博览会？

sentences.en: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century was the Crystal Palace
sentences.zh: 19世纪最不同寻常的建筑，或许就是水晶宫了，

sentences.en: which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
sentences.zh: 它是为1851年的万国博览会在海德公园建造的。

sentences.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
sentences.zh: 水晶宫与世界上所有其他建筑都不同，因为它是由钢铁和玻璃建造的。

sentences.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
sentences.zh: 它是迄今为止最大的建筑之一，许多国家的人们都前来参观。

sentences.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 许多商品从世界各地运到博览会展出。

sentences.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
sentences.zh: 还有大量机器展出。

sentences.en: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
sentences.zh: 展出的最精彩的机器是纳史密斯蒸汽锤。

sentences.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today,
sentences.zh: 尽管在那些日子里旅行不像今天这样容易，

sentences.en: steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
sentences.zh: 汽船还是载着成千上万的游客从欧洲渡过英吉利海峡。

sentences.en: On arriving in England, they were, taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
sentences.zh: 抵达英国后，他们乘火车前往水晶宫。

sentences.en: There were six million visitors in all,
sentences.zh: 总共有六百万游客，

sentences.en: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
sentences.zh: 博览会的利润被用于建造博物馆和学院。

sentences.en: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
sentences.zh: 后来，水晶宫被搬到了伦敦南部。

sentences.en: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
sentences.zh: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到1936年被烧毁。

sentences.en: Why did the prisoner attack the driver?
sentences.zh: 囚犯为什么要袭击司机？

sentences.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
sentences.zh: 杀死看守后，这名战俘迅速将他拖进了灌木丛。

sentences.en: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中迅速行动，他很快换上了死人的衣服。

sentences.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder,
sentences.zh: 现在，他身穿蓝色制服，肩上扛着一支步枪，

sentences.en: the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
sentences.zh: 这名囚犯大胆地在营地前走来走去。

sentences.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
sentences.zh: 他能听到营地里传来喊叫声。

sentences.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
sentences.zh: 灯火通明，人们四处奔跑：他们刚刚发现一名囚犯越狱了。

sentences.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一辆载有四名军官的黑色轿车在营地大门前停了下来。

sentences.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
sentences.zh: 军官们下了车，囚犯立正向他们敬礼。

sentences.en: When they had gone the driver of the car came towards him.
sentences.zh: 他们走后，轿车司机朝他走来。

sentences.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
sentences.zh: 那个人显然想说话。

sentences.en: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 他年纪相当大，头发灰白，眼睛湛蓝清澈。

sentences.en: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
sentences.zh: 囚犯为他感到抱歉，但他别无选择。

sentences.en: As the man came near the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
sentences.zh: 那人走近时，囚犯一记重击将他打倒在地。

sentences.en: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
sentences.zh: 然后，他跳进车里，以最快的速度开走了。

sentences.en: What was the monster called?
sentences.zh: 那个怪物叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
sentences.zh: 渔民和水手有时声称在海中见过怪物。

sentences.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen,
sentences.zh: 尽管人们常常嘲笑水手们讲述的故事，

sentences.en: it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
sentences.zh: 但现在已知，这些有时被目击到的“怪物”很多只是奇怪的鱼。

sentences.en: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，不寻常的生物会被冲到岸边，但它们很少在海上被捕获。

sentences.en: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
sentences.zh: 然而，不久前，一条奇特的鱼在马达加斯加附近被捕获。

sentences.en: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
sentences.zh: 当这条强壮的鱼拉扯鱼线时，一艘小渔船被拖离海岸数英里。

sentences.en: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
sentences.zh: 渔民意识到这不是一条普通的鱼，便竭尽全力不损坏它。

sentences.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
sentences.zh: 当它最终被带到岸上时，发现它有十三英尺多长。

sentences.en: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
sentences.zh: 它有一个像马一样的头，大大的蓝眼睛，闪亮的银色皮肤和一条鲜红的尾巴。

sentences.en: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
sentences.zh: 这条鱼后来被送往博物馆，由科学家进行研究，它被称为皇带鱼。

sentences.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
sentences.zh: 这种生物很少被人类活体发现，因为它们生活在六百英尺深的地方。

sentences.en: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克为什么一直问同一个问题？

sentences.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
sentences.zh: 前首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中失利。

sentences.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 他现在正退出政坛，并且已经出国了。

sentences.en: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生激进进步党的狂热反对者。

sentences.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
sentences.zh: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

sentences.en: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那儿时，值班警察告诉他，自从失利后，这位前首相就出国了。

sentences.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
sentences.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那所房子。

sentences.en: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
sentences.zh: 还是那个警察，他正慢慢地走过入口，这时帕特里克又问了同样的问题。

sentences.en: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
sentences.zh: 尽管这次有些怀疑，警察还是给了他同样的答案。

sentences.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
sentences.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又一次去了那所房子，问了完全相同的问题。

sentences.en: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
sentences.zh: 这次，警察发火了。

sentences.en: 'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted,
sentences.zh: “我昨天和前天都告诉你了，”他喊道，

sentences.en: 'Mr.Lane was defeated in the elections.
sentences.zh: “莱恩先生在选举中失利了。

sentences.en: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
sentences.zh: 他已经退出政坛并出国定居了！”

sentences.en: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
sentences.zh: “我知道，”帕特里克回答说，“但我喜欢听你说！”

sentences.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
sentences.zh: 下周谁来开公交车？

sentences.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
sentences.zh: 公交车司机们已决定下周举行罢工。

sentences.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 罢工定于周二开始。

sentences.en: No one knows how long it will last.
sentences.zh: 没人知道罢工会持续多久。

sentences.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
sentences.zh: 公交车司机们声明，罢工将持续到在工资和工作条件方面达成普遍协议为止。

sentences.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。

sentences.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
sentences.zh: 许多私家车车主将为上班族提供“免费搭车”服务。

sentences.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
sentences.zh: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
sentences.zh: 同时，一些大学生已志愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。

sentences.en: All the students are expert drivers,
sentences.zh: 所有学生都是驾驶专家，

sentences.en: but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
sentences.zh: 但在他们驾驶任何公交车之前，他们必须通过一项特殊的考试。

sentences.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
sentences.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

sentences.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
sentences.zh: 即使如此，人们仍然会发现上班很困难。

sentences.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，公众已通过写信给报社的方式表达了对学生的感激之情。

sentences.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
sentences.zh: 只有一两个人反对，认为学生们会开得太快！

sentences.en: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
sentences.zh: 佩奇先生教书多久了？

sentences.en: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我我们以前的校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生下周就要退休了。

sentences.en: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
sentences.zh: 学校的新老学生将送他一份礼物，以示纪念。

sentences.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
sentences.zh: 所有为这份礼物捐款的人都将在一个大相册上签名，这个相册将寄到校长家中。

sentences.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
sentences.zh: 我们都会记住佩奇先生的耐心和理解，以及当我们不情愿地去上学时他给予我们的亲切鼓励。

sentences.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 许多以前的学生将于下周四出席为他举行的告别晚宴。

sentences.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，在他退休的前一天，佩奇先生教书的总时长将满四十年。

sentences.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
sentences.zh: 退休后，他将致力于园艺。

sentences.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。

sentences.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
sentences.zh: 但这无关紧要，因为正如他常说的，活到老学到老。

sentences.en: What was the danger?
sentences.zh: 危险是什么？

sentences.en: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
sentences.zh: 当那人试图把快艇转弯时，方向盘脱落在他手中。

sentences.en: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 他绝望地向他的同伴挥手，他的同伴在过去的15分钟里一直在滑水。

sentences.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
sentences.zh: 两名男子还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛地甩进海里。

sentences.en: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
sentences.zh: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，但它仍然在水面上快速行驶。

sentences.en: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore,
sentences.zh: 两名男子刚开始向岸边游去，

sentences.en: when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
sentences.zh: 却沮丧地发现快艇正在画圈行驶。

sentences.en: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
sentences.zh: 它现在以惊人的速度径直朝他们冲来。

sentences.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
sentences.zh: 不到一分钟，它咆哮着从他们身边几英尺的地方冲过。

sentences.en: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
sentences.zh: 快艇驶过之后，他们尽力快速向前游，因为他们知道快艇很快就会回来。

sentences.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
sentences.zh: 他们刚来得及游出危险区域，快艇又完成了一圈。

sentences.en: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一次，它已经明显减速了。

sentences.en: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
sentences.zh: 汽油差不多用完了。

sentences.en: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
sentences.zh: 不久，噪音完全消失了，快艇开始在水面上轻轻地漂浮。

sentences.en: What was wrong with the man's story?
sentences.zh: 这个人的话有什么漏洞？

sentences.en: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
sentences.zh: “在谋杀发生的时候，我正坐8点钟的火车去伦敦。”那人说。

sentences.en: 'Do you always catch such an early train?' asked the inspector.
sentences.zh: “你总是赶这么早的火车吗？”探长问。

sentences.en: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.
sentences.zh: “我当然是。”那人回答。

sentences.en: 'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: “我10点钟必须上班。

sentences.en: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
sentences.zh: 我的雇主可以证明我准时到了那里。”

sentences.en: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?' asked the inspector.
sentences.zh: “晚一点的火车也能让你准时上班吗？”探长问。

sentences.en: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'
sentences.zh: “我想是的，但我从不赶晚一点的火车。”

sentences.en: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'
sentences.zh: “你什么时候到车站的？”

sentences.en: 'At ten to eight. I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
sentences.zh: “7点50分。我买了一份报纸，然后等火车。”

sentences.en: 'And you didn't notice anything unusual?'
sentences.zh: “你没注意到什么不寻常的事情吗？”

sentences.en: 'Of course not.'
sentences.zh: “当然没有。”

sentences.en: 'I suggest,' said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
sentences.zh: “我猜想，”探长说，“你没有说实话。

sentences.en: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train,
sentences.zh: 我猜想你并没有赶上8点钟的火车，

sentences.en: but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
sentences.zh: 而是赶了8点25分的火车，那也能让你准时上班。

sentences.en: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
sentences.zh: 你看，在谋杀发生的那天早上，8点钟的火车根本就没有开。

sentences.en: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
sentences.zh: 它在弗恩格林车站出了故障，被拉下了线路。”

sentences.en: Why is the rescue taking so long?
sentences.zh: 为什么救援用了这么长时间？

sentences.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
sentences.zh: 六名男子被困在矿井里已经十七个小时了。

sentences.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不尽快被带到地面，他们可能会失去生命。

sentences.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
sentences.zh: 然而，救援行动进展困难。

sentences.en: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
sentences.zh: 如果使用炸药，震动将导致矿井顶部坍塌。

sentences.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
sentences.zh: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个洞。

sentences.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
sentences.zh: 他们打算用一个特殊的胶囊将这些人带上来。

sentences.en: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil,
sentences.zh: 如果土壤下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，

sentences.en: they would have completed the job in a few hours.
sentences.zh: 他们几个小时就能完成这项工作。

sentences.en: As it is, they have been drilling for sixteen hours and they still have a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们已经钻了16个小时，还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago,
sentences.zh: 同时，两个小时前被放入矿井的麦克风，

sentences.en: has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
sentences.zh: 使这些男子能够与他们最亲近的亲属保持联系。

sentences.en: Though they are running out of food and drink,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们的食物和饮用水即将耗尽，

sentences.en: the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
sentences.zh: 这些男子仍然很乐观，并相信他们很快就能出来。

sentences.en: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知救援行动进展顺利。

sentences.en: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道钻穿坚硬的岩石有多困难，他们就会灰心丧气。

sentences.en: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
sentences.zh: 谁在那个晚上讲了唯一一个好笑的笑话，为什么？

sentences.en: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
sentences.zh: 人们会不惜一切去看免费演出——即使演出很糟糕。

sentences.en: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented
sentences.zh: 当喜剧表演将在当地电影院上演的消息传开时

sentences.en: at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
sentences.zh: 由P. and U. 鸟食公司在当地电影院呈现时，我们都抢着去看。

sentences.en: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
sentences.zh: 我们排了几个小时的队才进去，演出开始前肯定有几百人到场。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这场演出是我们看过的最乏味的一场。

sentences.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed,
sentences.zh: 那些没能进去的人大可不必感到失望，

sentences.en: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
sentences.zh: 因为许多本应出席的艺人都没有来。

sentences.en: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
sentences.zh: 那个晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的事情，来自节目开始时的广告商。

sentences.en: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
sentences.zh: 他显然非常紧张，几分钟内尴尬地站在麦克风前。

sentences.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
sentences.zh: 他一开口，每个人都哈哈大笑起来。

sentences.en: We all know what the poor man should have said,
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这位可怜人本该说什么，

sentences.en: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
sentences.zh: 但他实际说的是：“这是噗和咿鸟食公司。女士们，晚上好，先生们！”

sentences.en: What kind of fish are they?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么鱼？

sentences.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain,
sentences.zh: 炸鱼薯条一直是英国人最喜欢的菜肴，

sentences.en: but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive.
sentences.zh: 但由于海洋被过度捕捞，鱼类变得越来越昂贵。

sentences.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs.
sentences.zh: 因此，当得知巨型鱼类正在恐吓北海石油钻井平台的潜水员时，这令人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water,
sentences.zh: 石油钻井平台需要经常维修，而潜水员通常必须在水下百英尺的黑暗中工作，

sentences.en: have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work.
sentences.zh: 他们在工作时被撞到他们的巨型鱼吓得魂不附体。

sentences.en: Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
sentences.zh: 现在他们已经制造了特殊的笼子来保护他们免受这些“怪物”的侵害。

sentences.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales,
sentences.zh: 这些鱼不是鲨鱼也不是虎鲸，

sentences.en: but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes,
sentences.zh: 而是人们喜欢吃的品种，比如鳕鱼和鳐鱼，它们长得异常大，

sentences.en: sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至长达十二英尺。

sentences.en: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large:
sentences.zh: 有三个因素导致这些鱼长得如此巨大：

sentences.en: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea;
sentences.zh: 海底热油管道周围的温暖水域；

sentences.en: the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs;
sentences.zh: 钻井平台船员扔到海里的丰富食物供应；

sentences.en: the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
sentences.zh: 以及石油钻井平台周围完全没有渔船。

sentences.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water.
sentences.zh: 结果，这些鱼就在这宜人的暖水中不停地吃，不停地长大。

sentences.en: Who eats who?
sentences.zh: 到底是谁吃了谁？

sentences.en: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
sentences.zh: 车站的指挥官在哪里？

sentences.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
sentences.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正朝着附近的一个皇家空军基地飞去。

sentences.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
sentences.zh: 他立即通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这个谜团。

sentences.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news,
sentences.zh: 控制塔里的军官听到这个消息后非常生气，

sentences.en: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
sentences.zh: 因为气球对飞机来说可能是一个巨大的危险。

sentences.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
sentences.zh: 他说可能有人在监视基地，飞行员被命令跟踪这个奇怪的物体。

sentences.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
sentences.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一段时间。

sentences.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
sentences.zh: 他能辨认出气球下面的篮子里有三个人，其中一人拿着一副双筒望远镜。

sentences.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
sentences.zh: 当气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一个人在拍照。

sentences.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在一个机场附近。

sentences.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone,
sentences.zh: 警方被召来，但他们无法逮捕任何人，

sentences.en: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
sentences.zh: 因为篮子里坐着两名议会成员和基地的指挥官！

sentences.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
sentences.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的一半人不知道另一半人在做什么！

sentences.en: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?
sentences.zh: 警察为什么要叫这位作者到警察局去？

sentences.en: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
sentences.zh: 我回到家时，大约是凌晨两点钟。

sentences.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell,
sentences.zh: 我按门铃想叫醒我的妻子，

sentences.en: but she was fast asleep,
sentences.zh: 但她睡得很熟，

sentences.en: so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall,
sentences.zh: 于是我从花园的小屋里搬来一架梯子，把它靠在墙上，

sentences.en: and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 开始朝着卧室的窗户爬去。

sentences.en: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.
sentences.zh: 我快爬到窗户时，下面传来一个挖苦人的声音：

sentences.en: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
sentences.zh: “我认为窗户在夜间这个时候不需要擦洗。”

sentences.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
sentences.zh: 我向下看去，当看到一个警察时，我差点从梯子上掉下来。

sentences.en: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
sentences.zh: 我马上后悔不该那样回答，但我还是说：“我喜欢在夜间擦洗窗户。”

sentences.en: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
sentences.zh: “我也喜欢，”警察用同样的声调回答说。

sentences.en: Excuse my interrupting you.
sentences.zh: “请原谅我打断你一下。

sentences.en: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
sentences.zh: 我不愿意打断一个正在忙碌的人，但你介意跟我到警察局去一趟吗？”

sentences.en: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
sentences.zh: “嗯，我宁愿呆在这儿，”我说。

sentences.en: 'You see, I've forgotten my key.'
sentences.zh: “您瞧，我忘了带钥匙。”

sentences.en: 'Your what?' he called.
sentences.zh: “你的什么？”他大声问。

sentences.en: 'My key,' I shouted.
sentences.zh: “我的钥匙！”我喊道。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我的喊叫声把妻子吵醒了，她打开窗户，而此时那个警察刚开始向我爬过来。

sentences.en: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
sentences.zh: 自由女神像是在哪里制造的？

sentences.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty,
sentences.zh: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一，自由女神像，

sentences.en: was presented to the United States of America in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
sentences.zh: 在十九世纪由法国人民赠送给美国。

sentences.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
sentences.zh: 这座由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计的宏伟雕像，花了十年才完成。

sentences.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
sentences.zh: 实际雕像由铜制成，由埃菲尔专门建造的金属框架支撑。

sentences.en: Before it could be transported to the United States,
sentences.zh: 在它被运往美国之前，

sentences.en: a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
sentences.zh: 必须为它找到一个地点并建造一个基座。

sentences.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
sentences.zh: 所选地点是纽约港入口处的一个岛屿。

sentences.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
sentences.zh: 到1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像已在巴黎建成。

sentences.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
sentences.zh: 次年，它被拆解并运往美国。

sentences.en: By the end of October 1886,
the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
sentences.zh: 雕像已被重新组装，并由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

sentences.en: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty
sentences.zh: 从那时起，这座伟大的纪念碑一直是自由的象征，

sentences.en: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
sentences.zh: 对数百万穿过纽约港来美国安家的人们来说。

sentences.en: What kind of race do the children compete in?
sentences.zh: 孩子们参加的是哪种比赛？

sentences.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
sentences.zh: 实验证明，孩子们可以在很小的时候就被教导游泳。

sentences.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，

sentences.en: children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
sentences.zh: 孩子们甚至在学会走路之前就能熟练地在水下憋气。

sentences.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
sentences.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抵触下水。

sentences.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们就非常适应游泳了，甚至能从泳池底部捡起重物。

sentences.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
sentences.zh: 这些小泳者非常喜欢的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

sentences.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
sentences.zh: 三轮车排成一列，放置在水下七英尺深的泳池底部。

sentences.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
sentences.zh: 孩子们互相竞争，看谁先到达泳池的另一端。

sentences.en: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子会蹬他们的三轮车，但大多数人更喜欢推或拖它们。

sentences.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
sentences.zh: 有些孩子甚至可以游完整个泳池的长度而不用浮出水面换气一次。

sentences.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
sentences.zh: 他们将来是否会成为奥运冠军，只有时间能证明。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
sentences.zh: 同时，他们应该鼓励我们中那些游不到五码就气喘吁吁的人。

sentences.en: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
sentences.zh: 为什么大使特别幸运？

sentences.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
sentences.zh: 当埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子吓了一跳。

sentences.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
sentences.zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也糟透了。

sentences.en: 'What has happened?' she asked.
sentences.zh: “出什么事了？”她问道。

sentences.en: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
sentences.zh: “你的衣服怎么搞得这么乱？”

sentences.en: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
sentences.zh: “灭火器，亲爱的，”大使干巴巴地回答道。

sentences.en: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
sentences.zh: “今天早上大学生把大使馆点着了。”

sentences.en: 'Good heavens!' exclaimed his wife.
sentences.zh: “天哪！”他的妻子惊呼道。

sentences.en: 'And where were you at the time?'
sentences.zh: “那你当时在哪里？”

sentences.en: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
sentences.zh: “我像往常一样在办公室里，”大使回答道。

sentences.en: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
sentences.zh: “火灾发生在地下室。

sentences.en: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst,
sentences.zh: 我当然立刻下去了，然后那个傻瓜霍斯特，

sentences.en: aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
sentences.zh: 把灭火器对准了我。

sentences.en: He thought I was on fire.
sentences.zh: 他以为我着火了。

sentences.en: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
sentences.zh: 我一定要把那个家伙调走。”

sentences.en: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
sentences.zh: 大使夫人继续提问，

sentences.en: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
sentences.zh: 突然她发现丈夫的帽子上有一个大洞。

sentences.en: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.
sentences.zh: “那你怎么解释那个？”她问道。

sentences.en: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
sentences.zh: “哦，那个，”大使说道。

sentences.en: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
sentences.zh: “有人朝我办公室窗户开了一枪。

sentences.en: Accurate, don't you think?
sentences.zh: 够准的，不是吗？

sentences.en: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
sentences.zh: 幸好，我当时没戴着它。

sentences.en: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
sentences.zh: 如果我当时戴着，我就不能回家吃午饭了。”

sentences.en: What happens to the lanterns at the end of the festival?
sentences.zh: 节日结束后，那些灯笼会怎么样？

sentences.en: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本每年举行一次亡灵节。

sentences.en: This festival is a cheerful occasion,
sentences.zh: 这个节日是个欢乐的时刻，

sentences.en: for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
sentences.zh: 因为据说在这一天，逝者会回到他们的家园，受到生者的欢迎。

sentences.en: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them.
sentences.zh: 由于他们长途跋涉后会感到饥饿，人们会为他们摆放食物。

sentences.en: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.
sentences.zh: 每家每户外面都挂着特制的灯笼，帮助逝者找到回家的路。

sentences.en: All night long, people dance and sing.
sentences.zh: 人们通宵达旦地载歌载舞。

sentences.en: In the early morning the food that had been laid out for the dead
sentences.zh: 清晨，为逝者摆放的食物

sentences.en: is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
sentences.zh: 被扔进河里或海里，因为活人吃了被认为是不吉利的。

sentences.en: In towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before,
sentences.zh: 在沿海城镇，头天晚上挂在街上的小灯笼，

sentences.en: are placed into the water when the festival is over.
sentences.zh: 节日结束后会被放入水中。

sentences.en: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
sentences.zh: 数千盏灯笼缓缓地漂向大海，指引逝者返回另一个世界。

sentences.en: This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people
sentences.zh: 这是一幅感人的景象，因为成群的人们

sentences.en: stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
sentences.zh: 站在岸边，看着灯笼渐渐远去，直到它们完全消失不见。
